lines.en: scene black
You are now entering the Hug Dimension. You will not be able to leave until all of the hugs are complete.
lines.zh: 你即将进入抱抱维度。在所有抱抱完成之前，你无法离开。

lines.en: The following events are best enjoyed with a mug of hot chocolate and a warm cat on your lap.
lines.zh: 以下事件的最佳享用方式，是配一大杯热巧克力，腿上再趴一只暖烘烘的猫。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious1 with flash
Two young girls were spending their afternoon sitting beside one another, shielded from the cruelty of the world in this fortress of an apartment complex.
lines.zh: 两个小女孩正共度午后,彼此挨着,在这座公寓楼筑成的堡垒里,躲开了世界的残酷。

lines.en: The only problem is that one of them had already been exposed to the cruelty of the world just a couple nights ago when a large man decided to use her room for dance practice while she was still inside.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，她们其中一个在两天前的晚上就已经领教过这世界的残酷了——当时一个高大的男人决定把她的房间当成跳舞练习场，而她还待在里面。

lines.en: She hadn’t been able to stop thinking about this ever since it happened. None of the thoughts were good, though.
lines.zh: 从那件事发生起,她就没法停止去想。虽然没有一个念头是好的。

lines.en: As a matter of fact, none of them were really bad either. They were just thoughts. Confusion. Since when did he dance?
lines.zh: 事实上，那些也都不算真的坏。它们只是些念头。困惑。他什么时候开始跳舞了？

lines.en: So as she lay there beside a friend, she decided to keep her mouth shut. At least for now.
lines.zh: 所以,当她躺在朋友身边时,她决定闭紧嘴巴。至少暂时如此。

lines.en: But as she gazed down at a line of arithmetic she’d been using to distract herself, she thought of something to distract her from {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: 可当她低头盯着那行用来转移注意力的算术题时,她想到了{i}另一件{/i}能转移注意力的事。

lines.en: She remembered the sounds. Those slapping, wet sounds. She couldn't believe he had time to cook pasta in between dance moves.
lines.zh: 她记得那些声音。那些啪啪的、湿漉漉的声音。她不敢相信他居然能在跳舞动作之间抽空煮意面。

lines.en: Maybe she {i}should{/i} speak up? Maybe Chinami had seen something similar? Maybe she would better understand exactly what was happening if she was asked to weigh in?
lines.zh: 也许她{i}该{/i}说出来?也许 Chinami 见过类似的?也许让她来分析,她就能更明白那到底是怎么回事?

lines.en: Which isn’t to say Tsukasa {i}didn’t{/i} understand. She was a smart girl. She knew how to dance, probably.
lines.zh: 这不是说 Tsukasa {i}不{/i}懂。她是个聪明的女孩。她大概知道怎么跳舞。

lines.en: What was it called again? The Running Man? That was it, right? She remembered that. So cool.
lines.zh: 那个叫什么来着？跑步男？就是那个，对吧？她记得。超酷。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious2
Would it be called the Running Girl if a girl did it?
lines.zh: 如果是女孩做，会叫跑步女吗？

lines.en: : Mmm...
scene tsukasacurious3
She lets out a sound on accident. She hoped Chinami didn't hear her.
lines.zh: 她不小心发出了一声。她希望 Chinami 没听到。

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Tsukasa?

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious4
Crap.
lines.zh: 靠。

lines.en: : Chinami, what do you know about dancing?
lines.zh: : Chinami，你对跳舞了解多少？

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious5
Mission failed immediately. Now Chinami knew Tsukasa was a dancing girl.
lines.zh: 任务立刻失败。现在 Chinami 知道 Tsukasa 是个跳舞女孩了。

lines.en: : Wh...What?!
: Dancing. It’s when a man and a woman-
lines.zh: : 跳舞。就是当一个男人和一个女人——

lines.en: : Chinami knows what it is! She’s seen it on TV! She just wants to know why you’re asking something so mature!
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道那是什么!她在电视上看过!她只是想知道,你为什么会问这么成熟的问题!

lines.en: : You remember that we had your sister’s Christmas party at my house this year, right?
lines.zh: : 你记得今年你姐姐的圣诞派对,是在我家办的,对吧?

lines.en: : Of course Chinami remembers! She wanted to go but had to stay home alone because the outside world hates her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 当然记得!她想去,却只能一个人留在家里,因为外面的世界恨她。

lines.en: : Well, I may have...seen something.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我可能......看到了什么。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious6
: Mm...Big sis Chika has been going kinda crazy lately. Chinami thinks she wants Papa to love her more. So if you saw them dancing together-
lines.zh: : 嗯……Chika 姐姐最近有点发疯。Chinami 觉得她想让爸爸更爱她。所以如果你看到他们一起跳舞——

lines.en: : Your sister wasn’t involved. It was Jeeves and some other woman.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐没有参与。是 Jeeves 和另一个女人。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious7
: PAPA, NO!
lines.zh: : 爸爸,不!

lines.en: : Have you learned about that stuff yet, Chinami? Or, better yet, have you seen your sister and Jeeves do it together?
lines.zh: : 你学过那些东西了吗,Chinami?或者,更好一点,你见过你姐姐和 Jeeves 一起做吗?

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious8
: No! They don’t do that stuff in here! Or at least...not while Chinami is awake! She can’t confirm or deny what happens when she’s sleeping!
lines.zh: : 没有!他们不会在这里做那些!至少......不在 Chinami 醒着的时候!她睡着之后发生的事,她既不能证实也不能否认!

lines.en: : I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 原来如此，原来如此。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious9
: Oh well. Carry on then, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就当无事发生,我猜。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah. Chinami will...carry on.
lines.zh: : 好......好。Chinami 会......当无事发生的。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious10
And so the two of them went back to their books. One continued to fiddle with numbers while the other was neck-deep in a fight sequence between some green guy and some orange guy.
lines.zh: 于是两人重新看起书来。一个继续摆弄数字,另一个一头扎进绿皮人和橙皮人的打斗戏里。

lines.en: She forgot their names. It was hard to focus at the moment.
lines.zh: 她忘了他们的名字。眼下很难集中精神。

lines.en: They stayed like this for quite some time.
lines.zh: 她们就这样待了相当久。

lines.en: : What do you think it feels like?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那是什么感觉?

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious11
: Tsukasa!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！

lines.en: Until they didn’t.
lines.zh: 直到她们没能继续。

lines.en: : Is something the matter?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : Yes! We’re not supposed to talk about this kind of stuff! Stop trying to turn Chinami into a bad girl!
lines.zh: : 出事了!我们不许聊这种东西!别想把 Chinami 变成坏女孩!

lines.en: : But now is the perfect time to discuss topics we’d otherwise be banned from since there’s no one around to tell us we can’t. It’s just like when I give you insider trading tips.
lines.zh: : 可现在正是聊「平时被禁止的话题」的完美时机——周围没有人来禁止我们。就像我给你内幕交易贴士的时候一样。

lines.en: : Those are for Chinami’s secret 401k! She makes an exception for them since they directly impact her future!
lines.zh: : 那是给 Chinami 的秘密 401k 的!那些是例外,因为它们直接影响她的未来!

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious12
: Fine. I guess you’re just not mature enough to handle such an adult discussion then.
lines.zh: : 行。我猜你就是不够成熟,应付不了这种成人讨论了。

lines.en: : Chinami guesses so too. And that is fine with her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也这么猜。而且她完全接受。

lines.en: : I guess we’ll just go back to our books then.
lines.zh: : 那我们就回去看书吧。

lines.en: : Chinami is way ahead of you...
lines.zh: : Chinami 已经领先你一大截了......

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious13
: It looked kind of scary.
lines.zh: : 那看起来有点吓人。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious14 with flash
: If you’re trying to kill Chinami, at least do it with peanuts!
lines.zh: : 你要是想弄死 Chinami,至少用花生!

lines.en: : Pecans?
lines.zh: : 碧根果？

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious15
: Don’t pretend you didn’t actually hear what Chinami said! She hates it when you mix up nuts!
lines.zh: : 别装你其实没听到 Chinami 说什么！她讨厌你把坚果搞混！

lines.en: : I don’t know what else to do! I don’t want to tell my mom or my sister because they’ll probably get {i}mad{/i} at Jeeves! And I don’t want to ask Jeeves because...I feel like I...wasn’t {i}supposed{/i} to see that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还能怎么办!我不想告诉我妈或我姐,因为她们多半会{i}迁怒于{/i} Jeeves!我也不想问 Jeeves,因为......我觉得我......{i}不该{/i}看到那些。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious16
: Did you go somewhere you weren’t supposed to?
lines.zh: : 你去了不该去的地方?

lines.en: : Oh, no. They did it in my room.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。是他们在「我」房间里做的。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious17 with flash
: PAPA, NO!
lines.zh: : 爸爸,不!

lines.en: : She’s not going to have a baby now, is she?
lines.zh: : 她现在不会怀孕了吧?

lines.en: : I...uhh...does dancing make babies?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……跳舞会生宝宝吗？

lines.en: : I heard it does if you do it a lot.
lines.zh: : 我听说做得多了就会。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t want to know how many times they do it!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不想知道他们做多少次!

lines.en: : Really? Why?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : Because...she doesn’t. That’s Chinami’s dad. It’s gross. Also, why were they in your room?!
lines.zh: : 因为......她不想。那是 Chinami 的爸爸。恶心。另外,他们为什么在你的房间?!

lines.en: : Jeeves probably just remembered how exceptional the atmosphere was and wanted to impress that woman. Perhaps they were training for a competition?
lines.zh: : Jeeves 大概只是想起了那里的氛围有多出众，想给那个女人留下印象。也许他们在为比赛训练？

lines.en: : Oh. Maybe {i}that’s{/i} why they don’t do it in Chinami’s house then. Your house sounds better.
lines.zh: : 哦。也许{i}这就是{/i}他们不在 Chinami 家做的原因。你家听起来更好。

lines.en: : It is better. But that’s beside the point, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 确实更好。但那是题外话,Chinami。

lines.en: : Well, what {i}is{/i} the point?! Because Chinami is feeling very confused and very flustered right now and still thinks we shouldn’t be talking about this!
lines.zh: : 那重点{i}是{/i}什么?!因为 Chinami 现在非常困惑、非常慌乱,而且依然觉得我们不该聊这个!

lines.en: : It’s merely a bodily function. And surely the two of us will also be doing things like that one day. Wouldn’t it make more sense to understand them now so we’re not confused when that time comes?
lines.zh: : 那只是一种身体机能。而且 Surely 我们俩有一天也会做那样的事。现在先搞懂它,免得到时候一头雾水,不是更合理吗?

lines.en: : Chinami is never going to dance! She has bad knees!
lines.zh: : Chinami 永远都不会跳舞！她膝盖不好！

lines.en: : Maybe Jeeves will do it with you if you ask politely?
lines.zh: : 也许你礼貌地开口,Jeeves 就会和你做?

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious15 with flash
: GET OUT OF CHINAMI’S HOUSE! PAPA WOULD NEVER DANCE WITH HER! CHINAMI IS VERY UPSET ABOUT THAT!
lines.zh: : 滚出 Chinami 的家！爸爸绝不会跟她跳舞！Chinami 为此非常难过！

lines.en: : How do you feel about pineapple on pizza?
lines.zh: : 你觉得披萨上放菠萝怎么样？

lines.en: : CHINAMI THINKS IT'S VERY BAD!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得那非常糟糕！

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami! I’m home!
lines.zh: : Chinami！我回来了！

lines.en: : SISTER, NO!
lines.zh: : 姐姐,别过来!

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious18 with flash
: Oh, Tsukasa. You’re here too.
lines.zh: : 哦,Tsukasa。你也在啊。

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Shhhhh! Don’t say any of that stuff in front of Big Sis Chika!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通过巫师力量进行心灵感应交流～ 嘘——！别在 Chika 姐姐面前说那些东西！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Why not? She possesses the information that both of us lack. We can become dance experts with her guidance.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通过巫师力量进行心灵感应交流～ 为什么不行？她掌握着我们俩都缺的信息。在她的指导下我们能成为跳舞专家。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Chinami doesn’t want to be a dance expert! She'll never be able to walk again!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通过巫师力量进行心灵感应交流～ Chinami 不想当跳舞专家！她会再也走不了路的！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Do you think Big Sis Yumi is dancing with Jeeves too?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通过巫师力量进行心灵感应交流～ 你觉得 Yumi 姐姐也在跟 Jeeves 跳舞吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ No! But between us, I definitely think she wants to. Chinami always sees her practicing in the street.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通过巫师力量进行心灵感应交流～ 没有！但私下说，我绝对觉得她想。Chinami 老看到她在街上练习。{/i}

lines.en: : Why do I feel like there’s a whole lot of telepathic communication going on right now?
lines.zh: : 为什么我感觉这里正在进行大规模的心灵感应?

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious19
: Chika, can I ask you a question about something?
lines.zh: : Chika,我能问你一个问题吗?

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Please don’t! Chinami feels like you’re about to make her life a whole lot more difficult! And it’s already too hard for her!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 求你别问!Chinami 感觉你马上要让她的生活难上加难!而她现在已经够难了!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Don’t worry. I won’t tell her it was Jeeves. I don’t want that woman to be murdered.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 放心。我不会说那个男人是 Jeeves。我可不想那位女士被杀。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ That only kind of helps!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 那只是「有一点」用!{/i}

lines.en: : I still feel like there’s some telepathy going on here, but sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你们在进行心灵感应,不过行。怎么了?

lines.en: : What does “dancing” feel like?
lines.zh: : 「跳舞」是什么感觉？

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious20
: What does...what?! Where did you hear that word?! Dancing is banned in Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 什么……什么？！你在哪儿听到那个词的？！Kumon-mi 禁止跳舞！

lines.en: : I was watching one of the presentations my family provides about dank hip-hop beats this morning, but it lacked real world context that I believe would enhance the experience.
lines.zh: : 我今天早上在看我家提供的一个关于超赞嘻哈节拍的演示，但它缺少我相信能提升体验的现实世界语境。

lines.en: : Then...ask your mom?
: My mom hates me now. You’re my only hope.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈现在恨我。你是我唯一的希望。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious21
: What? Tsukasa, your mom does not {i}hate{/i} you. She loves you very much. Parenting is just...complicated sometimes. But I’m sure she’d gladly help you if you asked her about this.
lines.zh: : 什么?Tsukasa,你妈妈不{i}恨{/i}你。她非常爱你。为人父母只是......有时候很复杂。但我确信,你开口问她,她乐意帮忙。

lines.en: : Can’t {i}you{/i} just tell me? I know now that’s what you and Jeeves were doing when you played that really loud game at the onsen.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}就不能直接告诉我吗?我现在知道了——你们在温泉里玩那个超吵的游戏时,做的就是这个。

lines.en: : Jeeves?
lines.zh: : Jeeves?

lines.en: : She’s...talking about Papa...

: I know who she’s talking about. I’ve only gone on one onsen trip. There’s no way I could ever afford to actually {i}pay{/i} to stay in a place like that. And I don’t win radio contests often. Probably since it’s 2020.
lines.zh: : 我知道她说的是谁。我只去过一次温泉旅行。我绝对{i}付{/i}不起住那种地方的钱。而且我也不常赢电台竞赛。大概因为都 2020 年了。

lines.en: : Just tell me — on a scale of one to a thousand, how good does it feel?
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我——从一到一千,它有多爽?

lines.en: : Two thousand.
lines.zh: : 两千。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious22
: That’s so high! No wonder you and that other woman were so loud!
lines.zh: : 那么高!难怪你和那个女人那么吵!

lines.en: : {i}What{/i} other woman?!
lines.zh: : {i}哪个{/i}女人?!

lines.en: : From...the presentation I watched, obviously!
lines.zh: : 显然是......我看的那场宣讲里的!

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious23
: Tsukasa, since I’m only your {i}honorary{/i} sister at this point and not an {i}actual{/i} one, I’m going to keep this lesson extremely brief.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,鉴于我现在只是你的「{i}荣誉{/i}姐姐」、不是{i}亲{/i}姐姐,这一课我会讲得极其简短。

lines.en: : Dancing feels good because it’s all about establishing a connection with someone you really care about. When that happens, it’s one of the most amazing feelings in the world.
lines.zh: : 跳舞感觉很好，因为它全在于跟你真正在乎的人建立联系。当那发生时，那是世界上最棒的感觉之一。

lines.en: : And sure there are...other contexts where it {i}isn’t{/i} technically about that. But you are {i}way{/i} too young to be getting involved with that stuff, so don’t even worry about that part for now.
lines.zh: : 当然,也......有其他语境,严格来说{i}与这个无关{/i}。但你还{i}太小{/i},不该卷入那些,所以现在连想都不用想那部分。

lines.en: : I’m not involved! I only watched! I’m just curious. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我没有卷入!我只是看了!我只是好奇。就这样。

lines.en: : Watched...the presentation right? That your family put on?
lines.zh: : 看了......那场宣讲,对吧?你们家族办的?

lines.en: : Hm? Oh. Yes. Presentation.
lines.zh: : 嗯?哦。对。宣讲。

lines.en: : So you promise you’re not going to command one of your henchmen to teach you?
lines.zh: : 所以你保证,不会命令你的哪个手下来教你?

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious24
: Ew! Those guys?! I barely consider them human! If I was going to do it with anyone it’d be-
lines.zh: : 恶心!那种人?!我根本不把他们当人类!真要找个人做,那也是——

lines.en: : {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ DON’T YOU DARE MENTION ANY OF MY PAPA’S NAMES!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 你敢提「我爸爸」的任何一个名字试试!{/i}

lines.en: : American movie star, Seth Rogen!
lines.zh: : 美国电影明星,Seth Rogen!

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious25
: {i}Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ ?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!{/i}
: Is it because his feet are large and you think that would make him a better dancer?
lines.zh: : 是因为他脚大、而你觉得那会让他跳得更好吗？

lines.en: : I...like his laugh?
lines.zh: : 我......喜欢他的笑?

lines.en: : Tsukasa...don’t. Just don’t. Ask me again in like thirty years if you’re still curious, okay? Until then, just...do wizard stuff.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa......别。千万别。如果你三十年后还好奇,再来问我,好吗?在那之前,你就......玩你的巫术。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami! I’m going to start the bath. Is it okay if I go first today? I have plans in a couple hours and need time to do my makeup again.
lines.zh: : Chinami!我去放洗澡水了。今天我先洗可以吗?我几个小时后有安排,需要时间重新化妆。

lines.en: : Of course, Big Sis Chika! Anything for you, Big Sis Chika! I love you, Big Sis Chika!
lines.zh: : 当然，Chika 姐姐！为了你什么都行，Chika 姐姐！我爱你，Chika 姐姐！

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious26 with flash
: {i}You,{/i} though...
: I hope you enjoy your stay at the Holiday Inn later.
lines.zh: : 希望你待会儿在假日酒店住得愉快。

lines.en: : Chinami! You know we’re not allowed to say bad words.
lines.zh: : Chinami!我们不许说脏话的,你知道吧。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious27
: Holiday Inn isn't a bad word!
lines.zh: : 假日酒店不是脏话！

lines.en: : Then why did you use it as an insult?!
lines.zh: : 那你为什么拿它当骂人的话？！

lines.en: : Chinami doesn't know!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道！

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious28

: Fine. But one day, {i}you’re{/i} going to become a woman like me who has witnessed firsthand a bond between dancers and/or very good friends. And when that day comes, Chinami...I will not be there to help you.
lines.zh: : 行。但总有一天，{i}你{/i}也会变成像我这样的女人，亲眼见证过舞伴之间、或者非常好的朋友之间的羁绊。而当那一天到来，Chinami……我不会在那儿帮你。

lines.en: : Chinami sure hopes so because she feels like something really bad would need to happen for us to {i}both{/i} witness such a thing at the same time.
lines.zh: : Chinami 真心希望如此,因为她觉得,要让我们{i}俩{/i}「同时」见证那种事,得先出天大的坏事。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious29
: It’s not as bad as you make it sound, you know. It was kind of just...weird. But also interesting.
lines.zh: : 没有你说的那么糟啦。其实就......有点怪。但也挺有意思。

lines.en: : It didn’t last very long, though.
lines.zh: : 不过它没持续多久就是了。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know why, but she feels like you’re insulting her dad right now.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道为什么,但她觉得你这是在侮辱她爸。

lines.en: : Do you think I should tell him I saw his secret dance? Or would that be unbecoming of a lady like me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我该告诉他我看到他偷偷跳舞了吗？还是说那对我这样的淑女来说有失体面？

lines.en: : Why {i}would{/i} you tell him?
lines.zh: : 你为什么{i}要{/i}告诉他?

lines.en: : To use it against him as blackmail, of course. What kind of fool do you take me for?
lines.zh: : 当然是留着当把柄。你把我当什么傻子?

lines.en: : The fool who almost made Chinami learn the Running Girl!
lines.zh: : 那个差点让 Chinami 去学跑步女的蠢货！

lines.en: : So it is called the Running Girl after all. I knew it.
lines.zh: : 所以它果然叫跑步女。我就知道。

lines.en: : Does your mom really hate you? Chinami thinks that sucks.
lines.zh: : 你妈真的讨厌你吗？Chinami 觉得那太糟了。

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious30
: Maybe “hate” is too strong of a word, but...
lines.zh: : 也许「恨」这个字太重了,但是......

lines.en: : She certainly doesn’t want me. She basically told me outright.
lines.zh: : 她肯定不想要我。她基本是明说了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……

lines.en: scene tsukasacurious31
: But that’s okay! Tsukasa Tsukioka is stronger and smarter and more mature than {i}anyone{/i} gives her credit for! She’ll prove to everybody just how valuable she is! Mark my...{i}her{/i} words!
lines.zh: : 但没关系!Tsukasa Tsukioka 比{i}任何人{/i}以为的都更坚强、更聪明、更成熟!她会向所有人证明她多有价值!记......{i}她{/i}的话!

lines.en: : That just makes Chinami feel bad, so she’s decided to pay for your stay at the Holiday Inn.
lines.zh: : 那只会让 Chinami 心里难受，所以她决定替你付假日酒店的住宿费。

lines.en: : Nonsense, Chinami! I'm rich!
lines.zh: : 胡说，Chinami！我很有钱！

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll be staying at the Double Tree!
lines.zh: : 我会住逸林酒店！

lines.en: scene futabadad1
: Hah...guess I’ll try again tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 哈......看来我明天再试一次吧。

lines.en: : Something wrong, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabadad2
: Oh, Sensei. I thought you were Rin.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。我还以为你是 Rin。

lines.en: : Why would Rin knock on her own door?
lines.zh: : Rin 干嘛要敲自己的门？

lines.en: : She has dementia. Let’s not talk about it. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 她有痴呆。我们别谈这个了。你来这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I came here to see you. But if you’re in the middle of something, I can come back another time.
lines.zh: : 我是来看你的。不过你要是正忙着，我可以改天再来。

lines.en: scene futabadad3
: No, it’s fine. You’re barely here at all anymore. It’d be silly of me to let this chance slip through my fingers.
lines.zh: : 不，没事。你现在几乎都不怎么来了。我要是让这个机会从指缝里溜走，那就太傻了。

lines.en: scene futabadad4
: I’m not really busy anyway. I was just trying to call my parents, but they died ten years ago.
lines.zh: : 反正我也不怎么忙。我只是想给我父母打电话，但他们十年前就死了。

lines.en: : When was the last time you talked to them?
lines.zh: : 你上一次和他们说话是什么时候？

lines.en: scene futabadad2
: Over ten years ago.
lines.zh: : 十多年前。

lines.en: : They’re probably still dead. I just like to make sure sometimes
lines.zh: : 他们大概还是死的。我只是有时候喜欢确认一下

lines.en: : Well, on the bright side, at least they’re alive. That’s more than most girls in the class can say.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，至少他们还活着。这已经是班上大多数女生说不出口的事了。

lines.en: scene futabadad3
: Why don't you ever listen to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么从来不听我的？

lines.en: scene futabadad5
: Look at you doing something selfishly motivated for once.
lines.zh: : 看看你，难得做一次出于自私动机的事。

lines.en: scene futabadad6
: Wanting you to listen to me?
lines.zh: : 想让你听我说话？

lines.en: : What does that mean, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: scene futabadad7
scene futabadad8
: MWAHahahehehahohohooohoooohoaaa.
lines.zh: : MWAHahahehehahohohooohoooohoaaa.

lines.en: scene black
: Am I supposed to understand what you mean based on just that laugh alone?
lines.zh: : 你是想让我光凭那一声笑就明白你的意思吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure you can if you use your imagination, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我相信只要发挥一下想象力你就能明白，Sensei。

lines.en: Futaba tosses her phone to the side and stands up to face me, giving me a tight hug and reminding me of who I am.
lines.zh: Futaba 把手机扔到一边，站起来面对我，紧紧抱了我一下，也让我想起自己是谁。

lines.en: scene futabadad9
: Thank you for being so soft.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这么软。

lines.en: : And just like that, it’s like you were never even gone.
lines.zh: : 就这么一句话，感觉你好像根本没离开过。

lines.en: : Except I was. I only just got back from Lithuania yesterday.
lines.zh: : 但我确实去了。我昨天才从立陶宛回来。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad to hear that. They don't have dogs in Lithuania.
lines.zh: : 嗯，听到这个我很高兴。立陶宛没有狗。

lines.en: : How’s Ami doing? Last I heard, she was having a pretty tough go of it as well, wasn’t she?
lines.zh: : Ami 怎么样了？我上次听说她也过得挺艰难的，是吧？

lines.en: : Who?
scene futabadad10
: Oh no. Do you have dementia too?
lines.zh: : 哦不。你也有痴呆吗？

lines.en: : Oh, you mean my accountant. Like 95%% of her hair is gone now and she looks kind of like a boy.
lines.zh: : 哦，你说我的会计。她现在大概 95%% 的头发都没了，看起来有点像男孩。

lines.en: scene futabadad11
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : I hope it doesn't impact her accounting at all.
lines.zh: : 我希望那完全不影响她的会计工作。

lines.en: scene futabadad12
: Maybe you really {i}have{/i} changed since you’ve been gone.
lines.zh: : 也许你离开这段时间{i}真的{/i}变了。

lines.en: : I think I just have a lot of taxes.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我只是有很多税。

lines.en: scene futabadad13
: Maybe you really {i}have{/i} changed since you’ve been gone.
lines.zh: : 也许你离开这段时间{i}真的{/i}变了。

lines.en: : Okay, don’t just go repeating lines. In fact, ignore everything I said about taxes and just...look forward to her return. And don't throw rocks at her. She hates that.
lines.zh: : 好了，别老是重复台词。其实，忘掉我说的所有关于税的话，就……期待她回来吧。还有别朝她扔石头。她讨厌那样。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, I think she’d be very happy to have rocks thrown at her..
lines.zh: : 说也奇怪，我觉得她会很乐意被扔石头。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, I think you’re right. You are so persuasive.
lines.zh: : 说也奇怪，我觉得你说得对。你太有说服力了。

lines.en: scene futabadad14
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: And...how do {i}you{/i} feel about that?
lines.zh: : 那......{i}你{/i}对此是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Kind of...{i}good.{/i}
scene futabadad15
: I've always loved throwing hard objects at accountants.
lines.zh: : 我一直很喜欢朝会计扔硬东西。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you needed me to tell you that. That’s how it’s always seemed to most of us.
lines.zh: : 我很意外你还需要我来告诉你。在我们大多数人看来一直都是这样。

lines.en: : It’s easy to miss things when you’re intentionally throwing the rocks too high and far.
lines.zh: : 当你故意把石头扔得太高太远时，很容易错过东西。

lines.en: : You don’t need to explain it to me, Sensei. I’m happy for you. Ami too. Everyone loves a good rock.
lines.zh: : 你不用跟我解释，Sensei。我为你高兴。Ami 也是。大家都喜欢好石头。

lines.en: scene futabadad16
: Which will be really easy since I already have a crush on someone.
lines.zh: : 那应该很容易，因为我已经对别人着迷了。

lines.en: : Flirting with me is a dangerous move when you know how far I can throw stuff.
lines.zh: : 既然你知道我能把东西扔多远，跟我调情可是个危险举动。

lines.en: scene futabadad17
: Like {i}what,{/i} Sensei? Whatever do you mean?
lines.zh: : {i}什么样子{/i}，Sensei？你到底是什么意思呀？

lines.en: : Don’t play dumb, Futaba. You know we're talking about rocks.
lines.zh: : 别装傻，Futaba。你知道我们在说石头。

lines.en: : Weapons?...
scene futabadad18
: I don’t have any weapons...
lines.zh: : 我没有什么武器啊......

lines.en: : I said rocks, you crazy woman.
lines.zh: : 我说的是石头，你这疯女人。

lines.en: scene futabadad19
: You know, Sensei...I might have just had a little bit of an idea.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei......我可能刚刚想到了一个点子。

lines.en: : I’m listening...
scene futabadad20
: Well...as you saw just a few minutes ago, I’ve been a little beat up lately about not being able to get in touch with my parents.
lines.zh: : 嗯......就像你几分钟前看到的那样，最近联系不上我爸妈，让我有点受挫。

lines.en: : So maybe you could also die and then I could try to talk to you but it would work this time since you can talk while you're dead?
lines.zh: : 那也许你也可以死掉，然后我就能试着跟你说话，但这次会成功，因为你死了还能说话？

lines.en: scene futabadad21
: Will you...
scene futabadad22
: Die for me?...
lines.zh: : 为我死？……

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 求你了？

lines.en: : What have you become over these last few months?
lines.zh: : 这几个月你都变成什么样子了？

lines.en: scene futabadad23
: A murderer...
lines.zh: : 一个杀人犯……

lines.en: : Futaba wtf
lines.zh: : Futaba 搞什么鬼

lines.en: scene futabadad24
: Can’t you just play along?! This is really embarrassing for me!
lines.zh: : 你就不能配合一下吗？！我真的很难为情！

lines.en: : Oh, you're only joking?
lines.zh: : 哦，你只是开玩笑？

lines.en: scene futabadad25
: Maaaaybe a widdle bit...
: I just weawy wanna wurder womebody.
lines.zh: : 我只系真的很想杀个人。

lines.en: : D...Daddy?...
: I don't want to die right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在不想死。

lines.en: scene futabadad26
: I hate you.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌你。

lines.en: : Take your top hat off.
lines.zh: : 把你的高礼帽摘了。

lines.en: scene futabadad27
: Huh?
: Be a good girl and take your top hat off.
lines.zh: : 做个乖女孩，把你的高礼帽摘了。

lines.en: scene futabadad28
: I haven't worn a top hat since mom exploded.
lines.zh: : 自从我妈爆炸之后我就没戴过高礼帽了。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener3
: Did you like my story, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢我的故事吗,Akira?

lines.en: : What was it?
lines.zh: : 是什么来着？

lines.en: : Clifford the Big Red Dog: Clifford Goes to Hollywood.
lines.zh: : 《大红狗 Clifford：Clifford 闯好莱坞》。

lines.en: : I was paying attention. I just want to know what it was.
lines.zh: : 我在听。我只是想知道那到底是什么。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be a poet? I assumed creative analysis was well within your wheelhouse.
lines.zh: : 你不是个诗人吗?我以为创意分析完全在你的能力范围之内。

lines.en: : Just tell me what that has to do with a large red dog.
lines.zh: : 就告诉我那跟一只大红色狗有什么关系。

lines.en: : {i}Big{/i} red dog. Now, how about you tell me what the last season of Game of Thrones made you feel like.
lines.zh: : {i}大{/i}红狗。那么，不如你告诉我《权力的游戏》最后一季让你感觉如何。

lines.en: : It made me feel alone. Like I’ve been overlooking something that’s been right beside me this whole time.
lines.zh: : 它让我感到孤独。就好像我一直忽略了某个一直就在我身边的东西。

lines.en: : {i}This whole time{/i} meaning...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : {i}「一直」{/i}是指......具体多久?

lines.en: : I haven't seen my right hand in years.
lines.zh: : 我好几年没见过我的右手了。

lines.en: : Is that what you wanted? To make me feel alone?
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗?让我感到孤独?

lines.en: : Do you believe I’m the type to revel in the suffering of others?
lines.zh: : 你以为我是那种以他人的痛苦为乐的人吗?

lines.en: : If that suffering entertains you, yeah. I do.
lines.zh: : 如果那种痛苦能让你开心,那我是这么想的。

lines.en: : Then, allow me to rephrase — do you believe I’m the type to revel in the suffering of {i}the Irish?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那请允许我换个说法——你觉得我是那种会以{i}爱尔兰人{/i}的苦难为乐的人吗？

lines.en: : Oh no. We know one of those.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我们认识一个那种人。

lines.en: : I admire you, Akira. And a great deal at that.
lines.zh: : 我很欣赏你,Akira。而且是相当欣赏。

lines.en: : Why, I’d even let you hug me if you so desired. Which you probably do because you're the Huggy Boy
lines.zh: : 怎么，如果你愿意，我甚至愿意让你抱我。而你大概确实愿意，因为你就是抱抱男孩。

lines.en: : But why?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？

lines.en: : Why do {i}I{/i} have to be the Huggy Boy? The responsibility is too great.
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}我{/i}非得是抱抱男孩？这责任太大了。

lines.en: : I suppose I didn’t notice.
lines.zh: : 我猜我没注意到。

lines.en: : Do you know something, Nodoka? About hugs.
lines.zh: : 你知道什么吗，Nodoka？关于抱抱。

lines.en: : I know {i}many{/i} things, Akira. But none of them are about {i}hugs{/i} for I have never hugged anyone at all.
lines.zh: : 我知道{i}很多{/i}事，Akira。但没有一件是关于{i}抱抱{/i}的，因为我从来没抱过任何人。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener4
: You should feel bad for me now.
lines.zh: : 你现在应该为我感到难过。

lines.en: : Perhaps one day, this will make you want to hug me
lines.zh: : 也许有一天，这会让你想抱我

lines.en: : Do you love me?
lines.zh: : 你爱我吗?

lines.en: : I believe I do. Do you me?
lines.zh: : 我想是的。你爱我吗?

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太想，不。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener5
: Ah! My poor heart! This shock comes too quickly after my quadruple bypass surgery.
lines.zh: : 啊！我可怜的心脏！这个惊吓在我四重心脏搭桥手术之后来得太快了。

lines.en: : Have you told anyone about that?
lines.zh: : 你把这件事告诉过别人吗?

lines.en: scene afterthegardener6
: Just my diary.
lines.zh: : 只有我的日记。

lines.en: : And has that diary been published yet?
lines.zh: : 那本日记出版了吗?

lines.en: : It’s undergoing a few revisions as we speak. I spilled fruit punch on it.
lines.zh: : 就在我们说话的这会儿，它正在经历几处修订。

lines.en: : I bet you did.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。

lines.en: : Why did you take me all the way out here, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你为什么把我带到这么远的地方来,Akira?

lines.en: : Would you like to cut some of my hair off?
lines.zh: : 你想剪掉我一些头发吗？

lines.en: : I need your help finding my friend Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮我找我的朋友 Haruka。

lines.en: : You mean that girl right there?
lines.zh: : 你是说就在那儿的那个女孩？

lines.en: scene afterthegardener8
: Wow. You're so good at finding people.
lines.zh: : 哇。你太擅长找人了。

lines.en: : Well, look who we have here...
lines.zh: : 哟,看看这是谁来了......

lines.en: : Sorry I got lost again...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我又迷路了……

lines.en: : Did anyone see you?
lines.zh: : 有人看见你吗?

lines.en: : Unfortunately not.
lines.zh: : 可惜没忘。

lines.en: : I’m impressed, {i}Sensei.{/i} I didn’t realize you had enough influence in the local cafe scene to summon attractive baristas at will. When will you teach me your ways?
lines.zh: : 我真佩服你,{i}Sensei{/i}。我竟不知道你在本地咖啡馆圈子里有这么大的影响力,能随心所欲地把漂亮的咖啡师召唤过来。你什么时候教教我?

lines.en: : It’d be easier if she could understand directions.
lines.zh: : 如果她能听懂方向说明，会容易得多。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener9
: Hah...hahah...
: Have you tried giving her a map?
lines.zh: : 你试过给她一张地图吗？

lines.en: : She keeps asking for them, but she'll never become independent if she needs to rely on parchment.
lines.zh: : 她老是要地图，但如果她得靠羊皮纸，她永远也独立不了。

lines.en: : Oh?
: She also wants to hug you. It's supposed to be a secret.
lines.zh: : 她也想抱你。这本来该是个秘密。

lines.en: : All you had to do was ask, Haruka. I’ve tried giving you my number so many times.
lines.zh: : 你只要开口就行了,Haruka。我都试过那么多次想把号码给你了。

lines.en: : It was...embarrassing and...I’m not good at making the...first move...
: My, look at how bashful she is. It’s like she’s acutely aware she’s about to do something that could get her sent to jail.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,看看她多害羞。就好像她非常清楚自己接下来要做的事足以让她进监狱似的。

lines.en: : Oh no. Is hugging illegal too now? They already banned dancing. Was that not enough?
lines.zh: : 哦不。现在连抱抱也违法了吗？他们都已经禁了跳舞。还不够吗？

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Tell me, Haruka — why don’t you dress like this when you go to work?
lines.zh: : 告诉我,Haruka——你上班的时候为什么不穿成这样?

lines.en: : I...this...uhh...
: Oh no. I am lost again. Someone, help.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我又迷路了。谁来帮帮我。

lines.en: : Aww, how cute.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，多可爱。

lines.en: : I think it's kind of sad.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有点可怜。

lines.en: : Oh, here’s an idea — why don’t we take a photo to commemorate the occasion?
lines.zh: : 哦,我有个主意——我们拍张照片纪念一下这个场合怎么样?

lines.en: : W-What? Who are you?
lines.zh: : 什——什么？你是谁？

lines.en: scene afterthegardener10
: Oh no. She has Alzheimer's.
lines.zh: : 哦不。她有阿尔茨海默病。

lines.en: : Ahh! My face is gone!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！我的脸不见了！

lines.en: : No. It's right there, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 不。它就在那儿，Haruka。

lines.en: : Where? I- oh. Thank goodness.
lines.zh: : 哪儿？我——哦。谢天谢地。

lines.en: : Sensei, make her put her hands down. She has to listen to you, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei,让她把手放下来。她必须听你的,对吧?

lines.en: : I hope I locked the door to the cafe.
lines.zh: : 我希望我锁了咖啡馆的门。

lines.en: : Put your hands down, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 把手放下来,Haruka。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener11
: Sorry. I forget how to use them sometimes.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我有时候会忘记怎么用它们。

lines.en: : Turn and face Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 转过去,面对 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Who?
: Me.
scene afterthegardener12
: Hello.
lines.zh: : 你们好。

lines.en: : Oh my! Look at how obedient she is. Imagine all the tricks I could teach her if she was a big red dog.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！看她多听话。想象一下如果她是一只大红狗，我能教她多少把戏。

lines.en: : You don’t look very happy, Haruka. This is what you wanted, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你看起来不太开心,Haruka。这不就是你想要的吗?

lines.en: : Yes, but...
: Tell the camera what you want. I’ll start filming now.
lines.zh: : 对着镜头说出你想要什么。我现在开始录了。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener13
: An audition?!
lines.zh: : 试镜？！

lines.en: : Aaaaand action.
lines.zh: : 好——开机。

lines.en: : Uhh...umm...
: Slate, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 报幕，Haruka。

lines.en: : Haruka Hamasaki acting for the role of Daenerys Targaryen.
lines.zh: : Haruka Hamasaki 试演丹妮莉丝·坦格利安一角。

lines.en: : Remember, Sensei hates the final season.
lines.zh: : 记住，Sensei 讨厌最后一季。

lines.en: scene afterthegardener14
: Where are my dragons?????
lines.zh: : 我的龙在哪儿？？？？？

lines.en: : Stop right there. We've got all we need.
lines.zh: : 就停在那儿。我们要的都拿到了。

lines.en: : Already?
lines.zh: : 这么快?

lines.en: : The bar was really low.
lines.zh: : 标准真的很低。

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom1

lines.zh: : Ami？……

lines.en: : Yes, best friend?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，最好的朋友？

lines.en: : What’s going on?...
lines.zh: : 这是怎么回事？......

lines.en: : Hmm...you must’ve blacked out while we were on our way to the party. But don’t worry! I carried you all the way here by myself because I love you so darn much.
lines.zh: : 嗯......我们去派对的路上你一定是昏过去了。不过别担心！是我一个人一路把你背过来的，因为我实在是太爱你了。

lines.en: : Okay, but...
: Why are you holding that?...
lines.zh: : 你手里拿的什么？......

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom18 with flash
: NGH!?
lines.zh: : 嗯呃！？

lines.en: : Let’s get one thing straight — I am tired of doing {i}your{/i} taxes too. You know better than anyone that my real dream is to be a massage therapist.
lines.zh: : 先把一件事说清楚——我也受够给你{i}报税{/i}了。你比谁都清楚，我真正的梦想是当按摩治疗师。

lines.en: : Wanna guess where?
lines.zh: : 想猜猜在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : E...Envy?!
lines.zh: : E……Envy？！

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom19
: Good answer! They're one of the largest massage chains in the US!
lines.zh: : 好答案！他们是美国最大的按摩连锁之一！

lines.en: : What...do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 你......想从我这里要什么？

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom20
: Right now? Or in general? Because right now, I just want to relieve a little bit of that pent up tension you have in your upper back from working so hard all the time.
lines.zh: : 现在？还是一般来说？因为现在，我只想帮你缓解一点你上背部因为一直拼命工作而积攒的紧绷。
: 为、为什么？……

lines.en: : Obviously so you’ll stop digging through my toy box whenever I leave the house. You always pull the heads off of my WWE action figures. Those are collectible, darn it.
lines.zh: : 显然是为了让你别在我出门的时候翻我的玩具箱。你老是把我的 WWE 可动人偶的头拔下来。那些是可收藏品，可恶。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to borrow my things, and another to borrow my clothes. But pulling the heads off of the Hardy Boyz? That is unforgivable.
lines.zh: : 借我东西是一回事，借我衣服是另一回事。但把哈迪兄弟的头拔下来？那是不可原谅的。

lines.en: : But I'm...collecting them!
lines.zh: : 但我在……收集它们！

lines.en: : Just the heads?
lines.zh: : 只收集头？

lines.en: : It's all I have room for!
lines.zh: : 我只放得下这些！

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom21
: I’ve always...loved you, Ami...
: This is a weird time to confess that!
lines.zh: : 你挑这个时候坦白真够怪的！

lines.en: : What can I say...that will absolve me of the terrible wrestling-based sins I have committed?
lines.zh: : 我能说什么……才能赦免我犯下的那些可怕的摔角之罪？

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom22
: Nothing yet. It’s therapy time now. But maybe after we’re done, I’ll let you walk out of here in one piece? That is the goal as a licensed therapist, you know.
lines.zh: : 暂时没什么。现在是治疗时间。不过也许等我们做完，我会让你完整地走出这里？作为持证治疗师，那就是我的目标，你知道的。

lines.en: : You...are licensed?
lines.zh: : 你……有执照？

lines.en: : That’s right. {i}I can drive a forklift too.{/i} This is {i}my{/i} world. I'm an accountant, a masseuse, {i}and{/i} a warehouse manager.
lines.zh: : 没错。{i}我还会开叉车。{/i}这是{i}我的{/i}世界。我是会计、按摩师，{i}还是{/i}仓库经理。

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom23
: This thing cost me like $400.
lines.zh: : 这东西花了我差不多 400 美元。

lines.en: : You paid that much?
lines.zh: : 你花了那么多钱？

lines.en: : Anything to massage your back with, my dear.
lines.zh: : 只要能给你按摩背，什么都行，亲爱的。

lines.en: : But you don’t...even {i}like{/i} girls...
: So what? It's not like I'm going to hug you.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？我又不会抱你。

lines.en: : Would any of this have happened...if Niki didn’t move in?...
lines.zh: : 如果 Niki 没有搬进来......这一切还会发生吗？......

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom24
: I’ll bet {i}that’s{/i} the “development” that’s got you the most worried, right?...
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌，{i}那就是{/i}那个让你最担心的「发展」，对吧？......

lines.en: : Because I know you. You’re like me. You know we can’t compete with her....You said it earlier. That’s why we made a plan to...drag him back together...
lines.zh: : 因为我了解你。你和我一样。你知道我们比不过她......你之前也说过了。所以我们才定了个计划......一起把他拖回来......

lines.en: : You're confusing this route with the main one.
lines.zh: : 你把这条线和主线搞混了。

lines.en: : It's massage time.
lines.zh: : 现在是按摩时间。

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom25
: But I’ve gotta test your {i}aptitude{/i} first...
lines.zh: : 但我得先测试一下你的{i}资质{/i}......

lines.en: : I don’t want a client who isn’t loyal.
lines.zh: : 我不想要不忠诚的客户。

lines.en: : What are your rates?
lines.zh: : 你的收费标准是多少？

lines.en: : Do you think you can be loyal, Maya? To {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能忠心吗，Maya？对{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : I need to know your rates first.
lines.zh: : 我得先知道你的收费标准。

lines.en: : You can {i}love...{/i}just like a cat does...but you’ll never be {i}in love.{/i} That’s for humans.
lines.zh: : 你可以像猫那样......{i}去爱{/i}......但你永远不会{i}陷入爱河{/i}。那是人类的事。

lines.en: : What does that have to do with your rates? Why won't you just tell me?
lines.zh: : 那跟你的收费标准有什么关系？你为什么就是不肯告诉我？

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom26
: Is it only money that matters to you?
lines.zh: : 对你来说只有钱重要吗？

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom27
: Now I want to brush your hair even more!
lines.zh: : 现在我就更想给你梳头了！

lines.en: : Dear god...she's a one-woman salon.
lines.zh: : 天哪……她一个人就是一家沙龙。

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom28 with flash
: {i}This{/i} is what happens when you’ve grown tired of being tired.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是你厌倦了疲倦之后会发生的事。

lines.en: : It’s not all rainbows and unrequited love and {i}stars{/i} and watching all of your friends HUG the man you pine for because your self-esteem has persuaded you to take up the role of a tragic heroine.
lines.zh: : 这不是什么彩虹、单恋和{i}星星{/i}，也不是看着你所有的朋友去抱你暗恋的男人，因为你的自尊心说服你去扮演一个悲剧女主角。

lines.en: : I’m sure I was like that once too. But I stopped understanding the idea of “patience” when I realized just how infinite time here really is.
lines.zh: : 我大概也曾经是那样。但当我意识到这里的时间究竟有多无限之后，我就不再理解「耐心」这个概念了。

lines.en: : JUST TAKE MY WALLET, OKAY?!
lines.zh: : 拿走我的钱包就是了，行了吧？！

lines.en: scene returntoscaryroom29
: No. I'll take the {i}world{/i} away instead.
lines.zh: : 不。我改为拿走你的{i}世界{/i}。

lines.en: : This is going to dramatically impact my credit score.
lines.zh: : 这会严重影响我的信用评分。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle1
: So! Looks like it’s just you and me now. {i}Finally.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好啦！看来现在就剩你和我了。{i}终于{/i}。

lines.en: : Yay. I'm so excited to spend normal, platonic time with you while looking away for the entire duration because making eye contact with you would be inappropriate right now.
lines.zh: : 好耶。我太期待跟你度过正常、纯友谊的时间了，全程还得把脸转开，因为现在跟你对视是不合适的。

lines.en: : As you may have observed in the past, I am not exactly good at being quiet. But I don’t really mind if you heard either way.
lines.zh: : 你以前也见识过，我本来就不太会安静。不过被你听见我也不介意。

lines.en: : Heard what?
lines.zh: : 听到什么？

lines.en: : My barking, of course. I've done it 4,325,732,136 times so far today.
lines.zh: : 当然是汪汪叫啊。今天到现在我已经叫了 4,325,732,136 次。

lines.en: : There is absolutely no way it has been that much.
lines.zh: : 绝对不可能有那么多。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle2
: Probably not, {i}but I can wish.{/i}
lines.zh: : 大概没有，{i}但想想总行吧{/i}。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle3
: Arf.
: So much barking.
lines.zh: : 叫得真多。

lines.en: : What gave it away?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么看出来的？

lines.en: : All the barking.
lines.zh: : 所有的叫。

lines.en: : You know what makes me uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么让我别扭吗？

lines.en: : That your best friend keeps punching old people?
lines.zh: : 你最好的朋友老是揍老人？

lines.en: : Not being covered in three gallons of mustard right now.
lines.zh: : 现在没被三加仑芥末盖满。

lines.en: : You have a problem.
lines.zh: : 你有病。

lines.en: : Shut up, ketchup boy.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，番茄酱小子。

lines.en: : Don’t say it again.
lines.zh: : 别再说了。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle4
: Fine. But I refuse to let this rare opportunity of being alone with you in a fancy mansion go to waste! Come with me!
lines.zh: : 行吧。但我绝不能让这个跟你单独待在一座豪华大宅里的难得机会白白浪费！跟我来！

lines.en: : Come with you to where? Mustard?
lines.zh: : 跟你去哪儿？芥末？

lines.en: : That’s not for another forty-five minutes and all of the girls are in the dining hall right now. I want to explore because, let’s face it, the chance of {i}me{/i} ever living in a place like this is less than zero.
lines.zh: : 那还要四十五分钟呢，而且女孩们现在都在餐厅。我想逛逛——因为，面对现实吧，{i}我{/i}这辈子住进这种地方的概率小于零。

lines.en: : We’re going to get lost.
lines.zh: : 我们会迷路的。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I have the Tsukioka Manor GPS app. This is the event where that originated.
lines.zh: : 没事。我有 Tsukioka 宅邸的 GPS 应用。这就是那个应用起源的事件。

lines.en: : Why is there a Tsukioka Manor GPS app?
lines.zh: : 为什么会有「月冈宅邸 GPS」App？

lines.en: : So we know how to always avoid Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 这样我们就永远知道怎么躲开 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : That’s-
: You know what. That’s fair. But I still don’t think it’s a good idea to-
lines.zh: : 好吧。说得也是。可我还是觉得这不是个好主意——

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle5
: I’ll let you hold my leeeeaaaaash~
lines.zh: : 我让你牵我的「牵引绳」嘛～

lines.en: : Okay, that is {i}definitely{/i} not a good idea.
lines.zh: : 好，那{i}绝对{/i}不是好主意。

lines.en: : This is inappropriate and I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 这不合礼数，我要走了。

lines.en: scene black
: Then you'll never see my clown costuuUuuUuUUuuuumEEEEE.
lines.zh: : 那你就永远看不到我的小丑服——服——服——服——服——装——了——

lines.en: : That's not how you capitalize things.
lines.zh: : 大写不是那么用的。

lines.en: : Ugh...you’re right. I'll try harder.
lines.zh: : 呃……你说得对。我会更努力。

lines.en: Chika and I walk through the halls of the manor. It's really nice and big. Like Clifford the dog.
lines.zh: 我和 Chika 走过宅邸的走廊。真的很漂亮，也很大。像那条叫 Clifford 的狗。

lines.en: Thankfully, we don’t run into anyone {i}at all{/i} as it seems the entirety of the class really is in the dining hall at the moment.
lines.zh: 好在我们一个人{i}都{/i}没撞上——看来全班这会儿确实都在餐厅。

lines.en: And while that is certainly a place I would like to be as well considering investing really runs up an appetite, I {i}also{/i} want to savor this moment with Chika.
lines.zh: 虽然餐厅也是我想待的地方（毕竟「投资」真能让人胃口大开），但我{i}也{/i}想好好珍惜跟 Chika 相处的这一刻。

lines.en: At first, I was indifferent.
lines.zh: 起初，我没什么感觉。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle6
: {i}Oh my God...{/i}
But the moment her eyes lit up upon walking into a more western style grand foyer...I realized just how much of a fantasy this must be for her. And I just want her to be happy.
lines.zh: 但当她走进一个更西式的大门厅、眼睛亮起来的那一刻……我意识到这对她来说一定有多像一场幻想。而我只想让她开心。

lines.en: : This place is, like...like something out of Cinderella. Or Titanic or...Sensei, name some other movies with really lavish rooms like this.
lines.zh: : 这地方简直......像《灰姑娘》里出来的。或者《泰坦尼克号》......Sensei，再说几个有这种超豪华房间的电影。

lines.en: : The original 1962 Mattel Barbie's Dream House.
lines.zh: : 1962 年原版 Mattel 芭比梦想屋。

lines.en: : That's not a movie.
lines.zh: : 那不是电影。

lines.en: : No, but it should be.
lines.zh: : 不是，但它该是。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle7
: Sensei...you should get rich so we can live in a place like this one day.
lines.zh: : Sensei......你该发财，这样哪天我们也能住这种地方。

lines.en: : This is not what I had in mind when I monologued about building a castle that one time.
lines.zh: : 这跟我那次「内心独白」里说的「建一座城堡」可不一样。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle8
: Castle? Monologue? Was I there for that?
lines.zh: : 城堡？独白？那会儿我在场吗？

lines.en: : In the background, yeah. Just a thought I had once.
lines.zh: : 在，当个背景。只是我曾经有过的一个念头。

lines.en: : It feels like such a long time ago at this point, though.
lines.zh: : 不过现在回想起来，感觉好久以前了。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle9
: Yeah. We’ve sure come a long way, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们确实走了很远，对吧？

lines.en: : Thinking that while standing in a place like this makes it feel like the final scene of a movie.
lines.zh: : 站在这种地方想这些，感觉像电影的最后一幕。

lines.en: : You must really like movies if you keep bringing them up.
lines.zh: : 你老是提起电影，看来真的很喜欢。

lines.en: : I know, but {i}just look at it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道，可{i}你看看这地方{/i}。

lines.en: : When you grow up in a tiny apartment in a run-down neighborhood, you really start to forget that places like this actually exist and aren’t just made up.
lines.zh: : 在破败街区的小公寓里长大，你真的会慢慢忘了这种地方是真实存在的，不是编出来的。

lines.en: : I think the Tsukiokas are a rare case and that this isn’t really a good indicator of life outside of your bubble. Especially when your bubble contains no actual bubbles. What's up with that?
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Tsukioka 家是个罕见的例子，这并不能真正代表你泡泡之外的生活。尤其当你的泡泡里根本没有任何实际的泡泡。那是怎么回事？

lines.en: : That’s just the thing, though. {i}All{/i} of us in that bubble dream of having stuff like this one day, but we know that it’s a height we’ll never be able to reach.
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿。我们这些圈中人，{i}都{/i}梦想有一天能拥有这样的生活，可又清楚那是永远够不到的高度。

lines.en: : So, instead...we rely on tiny bursts of luxury like new accessories or HBO movie rentals or...bleaching our hair or...getting an extra topping on pizza. The little stuff, you know?
lines.zh: : 所以......我们就靠一点点小小的奢侈撑着——比如买个新配饰、在 HBO 上租部电影、漂个头发、披萨上加份料。都是些小事，你懂吧？

lines.en: : And seeing something like this...you don’t feel disheartened? Or think it’s a waste of money? Because this hall is probably worth more than your entire building and it’s not even being used.
lines.zh: : 可看到这种地方......你不会灰心吗？或者觉得这是浪费钱？毕竟这个大厅大概比你整栋楼都值钱，还根本没人用。

lines.en: : Jealous, sure. But disheartened? Not at all.
lines.zh: : 嫉妒是有的。但灰心？一点都没有。

lines.en: : I’m happy there are people who get to live like this...in their own little fairy tales.
lines.zh: : 我为那些能这样生活的人高兴......他们活在自己的小童话里。

lines.en: : But I guess I shouldn’t be {i}too{/i} jealous.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我也不该{i}太{/i}嫉妒。

lines.en: : And why’s that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle10
: Because...I’ve got my own fairy tale.
lines.zh: : 因为......我也有我自己的童话。

lines.en: : What is it?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: : Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves.
lines.zh: : 《阿里巴巴与四十大盗》。

lines.en: : I love that one. Great choice.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢那个。好选择。

lines.en: : If I had to choose between you and the house, though...I’d definitely go with the house. I’m not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 不过要我在你和这栋房子之间选......我肯定选房子。我又不傻。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’d go with the house too. And thanks for retroactively making your previous statement less cute. I think I’ve finally regained feeling in my legs and can walk again.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也会选房子。而且谢谢你把你上句话说得没那么可爱了。我想我的腿终于恢复知觉，能走了。

lines.en: : Want to put ‘em to use and look around a little more? I doubt Tsubasa will care if it’s just us.
lines.zh: : 想不想再走走、多逛逛？就我们俩的话，Tsubasa 多半不会介意。

lines.en: : If she even finds us, you mean. Which I highly doubt she will considering just how massive this place is.
lines.zh: : 前提是她找得到我们。我觉得她找不到，这地方太大了。

lines.en: : Then it shouldn’t be a problem at all. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那就一点问题都没有了。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Sorry, I was just thinking about bees.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我刚才在想蜜蜂。

lines.en: scene black
: Why are you always doing that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么老是那样？

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle11
I wonder if there are any bees in here.
lines.zh: 不知道这里有没有蜜蜂。

lines.en: : Are you doing it again?
lines.zh: : 你又来了？

lines.en: : Yeah.
scene poorgirldoggystyle12
: So, now what? We're gonna have to cut to black in a few seconds.
lines.zh: : 那现在呢？我们几秒钟后就得切黑了。

lines.en: : We could jump up and down on the bed, we just have to be careful.
lines.zh: : 我们可以在床上跳上跳下，只是得小心点。

lines.en: : We don’t even know whose bed this is.
lines.zh: : 我们连这是谁的床都不知道。

lines.en: : That was my line in the original.
lines.zh: : 在原版里那是我的台词。

lines.en: scene poorgirldoggystyle13
: And?
lines.zh: : 还有呢？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Just how often do you think about bees?
lines.zh: : 你到底多久想一次蜜蜂？

lines.en: : Oh no.
lines.zh: : 糟了。

lines.en: : I was just wondering why you aren’t bees.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想你为什么不是蜜蜂。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties1 with flash
: Oh, Sensei! What’s up? I was actually just thinking about you.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！怎么啦？我刚才其实正在想你呢。

lines.en: : Was it about how they should have cast me in Pineaplle Express instead of Seth Rogen?
lines.zh: : 是不是说他们本该让我演《菠萝快车》而不是 Seth Rogen？

lines.en: I leverage my position of power to embarrass her but only embarrass myself.
lines.zh: 我利用自己的权力地位想让她难堪，结果只让自己难堪。

lines.en: : If you’re waiting for a punchline, there isn’t one. That's why they chose him instead.
lines.zh: : 如果你在等笑点，没有。所以他们才选了他。

lines.en: : You...You’re just carrying around my baseball cards?
lines.zh: : 你……你就这么随身带着我的棒球卡？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我想了。

lines.en: : The...baseball cards that were in my pocket the other day? The ones that I took out because they got soaked from the rain?
lines.zh: : 就是……前几天在我口袋里的那些棒球卡？我因为被雨淋湿了才拿出来的那些？

lines.en: : Is there something about that you’re not understanding?
lines.zh: : 这里面有什么你没搞懂的地方吗？

lines.en: : Yes. The part where you took them. And the part where you stuffed them into your pocket. And the part where you are now confessing your evils to me instead of just keeping them and preventing this talk.
lines.zh: : 有。你拿走它们的部分。你把它们塞进口袋的部分。还有你现在跑来向我坦白罪行、而不是干脆留着它们好省掉这场对话的部分。

lines.en: : I just figured you’d want them back since they might be worth something one day
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你可能会想要回去，因为它们有一天也许值点钱

lines.en: scene utadormpanties2
: Me storming out has nothing to do with whether or not it’s okay to just walk around with my rookie Jackson Holliday like it's some kind of badge of honor! He was a total flop!
lines.zh: : 我冲出去跟「拿着我的新秀卡 Jackson Holliday 到处走、好像那是什么荣誉徽章」可不可以，一点关系都没有！他彻底是个水货！

lines.en: : You don’t see me walking around with giant feet, do you?
lines.zh: : 你也没看到我带着一双巨脚到处走吧？

lines.en: : No. But that's just because your feet are normal size.
lines.zh: : 没有。但那只是因为你的脚是正常尺寸。

lines.en: : What? But you wear jeans like, every day. Doesn’t that make you uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 什么？可你几乎每天都穿牛仔裤啊。那样不难受吗？

lines.en: : I don't see what that has to do with-
lines.zh: : 我看不出那跟——有什么关系

lines.en: scene utadormpanties3
: Hah...You know, if I didn’t grow up with an older brother who saw my hands on the floor every time he came into my room, this would be a real shock for me right now.
lines.zh: : 哈……你知道，如果我不是跟一个每次进我房间都能看到我手撑在地上的哥哥一起长大的，现在这对我来说会是真正的震撼。

lines.en: : Oh god, it's happening again.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪，又来了。

lines.en: : I expected better from you, Sensei. Especially after our fateful night of trampolining together should have gotten all of that pent up energy out of your system.
lines.zh: : 我对你有更高的期待，Sensei。尤其在我们那个命中注定的蹦床之夜之后，那本该把你体内积攒的能量全排出去的。

lines.en: : I can’t say that spending the majority of the night in there alone while waiting for you to finish researching the origins of the trampoline was very fun at-
lines.zh: : 我不能说，独自待在里面度过大半个夜晚、等你研究完蹦床的起源，有多好玩，在——

lines.en: scene utadormpanties4
: Well, you’re smiling now, aren’t you? Which means that you remember fun exists! You remember how to feel!
lines.zh: : 嗯，你现在在笑，对吧？这说明你还记得「好玩」是存在的！你还记得怎么去感受！

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 或者什么的。

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : What? The conversation is over. Just give me my money and leave.
lines.zh: : 什么？谈话结束了。把钱给我然后走。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties1
: Wait, you didn’t actually do anything with my lunch, did you? Because that would be weird and gross and not entirely unexpected.
lines.zh: : 等等，你没真的对我的午饭做了什么吧？因为那会又怪又恶心，而且也不完全出乎意料。

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。

lines.en: : Are you lying to me, you salt-stealing coward?
lines.zh: : 你在骗我吗，你这个偷盐的胆小鬼？

lines.en: : No more than you’re lying to me about why you left the hotel.
lines.zh: : 不比你骗我——骗我你为什么离开酒店——来得更多。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties5
: Hah...Sensei, it’s not really {i}lying{/i} if I just...don’t tell you certain things, is it?
lines.zh: : 哈......Sensei，如果我只是......有些事没告诉你，那也算不上{i}骗{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Not really. But I think there’s an argument to be made about whether or not certain scenarios arise in which that {i}would{/i} be lying, right?
lines.zh: : 严格说不算。不过我觉得可以论证一下：会不会存在某些情形，那样做也算{i}骗人{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: : If I were to get a mysterious text and storm out of the room right now, you’d definitely think I was hiding something, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 要是我现在收到一条神秘短信然后冲出房间，你肯定会觉得我在瞒着什么，对吧？

lines.en: : So, what? You want to know who sent me that message? Will that make you drop this?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你想知道是谁给我发了那条消息？知道这个你就能放过这件事了吗？

lines.en: : It would be a start.
lines.zh: : 至少是个开始。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties6
: Well, sucks for you because I don’t even know.
lines.zh: : 那你倒霉了，因为我自己都不知道。

lines.en: : I don’t believe that.
lines.zh: : 我不信。

lines.en: : Believe whatever you want. If it was something I thought you should know, I wouldn’t have just left without saying anything.
lines.zh: : 你爱信不信。如果那是我认为你该知道的事，我就不会一声不吭地走掉了。

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say the other day that you want me to know more about you, though?
lines.zh: : 可你前几天不是刚说过，你想让我多了解你一点吗？

lines.en: : Do you remember what I said after that?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我那之后说了什么吗？

lines.en: : No. I saw a bird and got distracted.
lines.zh: : 没有。我看到一只鸟，走神了。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} remember, because both parts of what I said are still true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}记得，因为我说的两半都还成立。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} want you to know more about me. I just don’t want you to know anything that might make you look at me differently.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}想让你多了解我。我只是不想让你知道任何可能改变你看我的眼光的事。

lines.en: : Is that not the purpose of learning more about someone? Changing the way you look at them?
lines.zh: : 可了解一个人不就是为了改变你看他的方式吗？

lines.en: : Not when I already like the way we look at each other.
lines.zh: : 当我已经喜欢我们现在看彼此的方式时，就不是了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties7
: So anyway! That was embarrassing! But I’m glad we’ve finally moved on!
lines.zh: : 那么总之！刚才那段挺丢人的！不过我很高兴我们终于翻篇了！

lines.en: : Have we?
lines.zh: : 翻篇了吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties8
: You know, I like you a lot better when you’re not trying to pry into my personal life.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你不打探我私生活的时候，我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : I just want to know more about you. Whether or not that changes the way I look at you is up to me.
lines.zh: : 我只是想多了解你。那会不会改变我看你的方式，取决于我自己。

lines.en: : Even if it does, though, wouldn’t that just mean I’m {i}not{/i} someone you want to get closer to anyway? Wouldn’t your interest be better spent on someone who will, you know, {i}understand{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 可就算会，那不也正说明我{i}不是{/i}你想要靠近的人吗？你的兴趣放在某个能......{i}理解{/i}你的人身上不是更好吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties9
: No.
lines.zh: : 不用。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because it’s better for everyone if you never understand me.
lines.zh: : 因为对所有人来说，你永远都别理解我才好。

lines.en: : It’s better if I’m Captain Uta.
lines.zh: : 我当 Uta 队长更好。

lines.en: : Captain Uta is the perfect girl who always makes the right decisions. Who hangs onto her baseball cards so the hugmen can't get them.
lines.zh: : Uta 队长是永远做出正确决定的完美女孩。她会牢牢守住自己的棒球卡，不让抱抱人拿到。

lines.en: : She never makes mistakes or does things she looks back on with regret.
lines.zh: : 她从不犯错，也从不回头看自己做过的事而后悔。

lines.en: : And that’s all Uta Ushibori ever does.
lines.zh: : 而 Uta Ushibori 所做的一切，就只有后悔。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties10
: W...Why do you want to get to know me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为......为什么你想了解我，Sensei？

lines.en: : Why did you ask me to stop being Captain uta when we were in that hotel?
lines.zh: : 我们当时在那家酒店，你为什么让我别再当 Captain Uta 了？

lines.en: : It was hard to jump up and down with you flying around the room like that. Your cape was so long..
lines.zh: : 你那样在房间里飞来飞去的时候，很难跳上跳下。你的斗篷太长了……

lines.en: scene utadormpanties11
: Our pasts aren’t what define us, you know. You can still wear the cape.
lines.zh: : 你知道，定义我们的不是过去。你依然可以披着那件斗篷。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: : Also, if there are things you did in the past that turned you into the person you are today, even if those things are ten times uglier by comparison, I still want to know about them because they made {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有，如果过去有些事把你变成了今天的你，就算那些事相比之下丑陋十倍，我还是想知道，因为它们造就了{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Captain Uta is great because she’s perfect. But Uta Ushibori is great too because she smells nice and has normal size feet.
lines.zh: : Uta 队长很棒，因为她完美。但 Uta Ushibori 也很棒，因为她闻起来很香，而且脚是正常尺寸。

lines.en: : Are you telling me you want me to suffer?
lines.zh: : 你是在告诉我，你想让我受苦？

lines.en: : That's not even close to what I said.
lines.zh: : 这跟我说的差得远了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties12
: Of course you’d be an actor. Why am I not surprised?
lines.zh: : 你当然会是个演员。我为什么一点都不意外？

lines.en: : Do you know something about Pineapple Express?
lines.zh: : 你知道关于《菠萝快车》的什么事吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties13
: I’ll talk. I just...
lines.zh: : 我会谈的。我只是......

lines.en: : You’ll be the first person other than Io or my family who’s ever heard any of this.
lines.zh: : 除了 Io 和我家人之外，你是第一个听到这些的人。

lines.en: : It’ll be with less, uhh...{i}specifics,{/i} though...because I still {i}am{/i} worried that you’ll figure me out one day and not want anything to do with me anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过会少一些，呃......{i}细节{/i}......因为我还是{i}确实{/i}担心有一天你会看清我，然后就再也不想跟我有任何关系了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties14
: That would be a huge blow financially. And I don’t know if I’d ever be able to recover from losing my number one customer.
lines.zh: : 那在经济上会是巨大的打击。而且我不知道失去头号顾客之后我还能不能缓过来。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties13
: Uhh...let’s see...
: Okay, I guess the easiest way of putting it would be...
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想最简单的说法是......

lines.en: : I’ve, uhh...
: I’ve done some...{i}stuff...{/i}that I’m not very proud of in the past...
lines.zh: : 我以前做过一些......{i}事{/i}......我并不怎么自豪的事......

lines.en: : Impulsive stuff. Like...when I pulled you into the tea ceremony room the other day but, like...worse than that.
lines.zh: : 冲动的事。就像......那天我把你拉进茶室那样，但，比如......比那更糟。

lines.en: : A lot worse.
lines.zh: : 糟得多。

lines.en: : Stuff that seemed like a really great idea at the time...
lines.zh: : 那些在当时看起来真是个绝妙主意的事......

lines.en: : But...when you’re all on your own in Hollywood, it’s...uhh...it’s easier to not really understand the possible, uhh...consequences for your actions...
lines.zh: : 但……当你在好莱坞独自一人时，就……呃……更容易不真正理解你的行为可能带来的、呃……后果……

lines.en: : And so some of those great ideas wind up coming back to bite you.
lines.zh: : 于是那些绝妙的主意里，有一些最后会回过头来咬你一口。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties15
: I, uhh...I guess I haven’t ever told you the real reason I moved here, have I?
lines.zh: : 我，呃......我想我从来没告诉过你我搬来这儿的真正原因，对吧？

lines.en: : You’ve told me about your dead grandpa a hundred times. I’m not sure if that was just to make me sad, though.
lines.zh: : 你跟我说过你死去的爷爷一百次了。不过我不确定那是不是只是为了让我难过。

lines.en: : That was part of it. But, uhh...the bigger part is that I was dealing with this, uhh...{i}issue{/i} back at home.
lines.zh: : 那是其中一部分。可是，呃......更大的一部分是，我在老家的时候在处理这个，呃......{i}麻烦{/i}。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties16
: That stuff about bad decisions and...consequences we don’t really think of when we’re that famous...
lines.zh: : 那些关于糟糕决定和……我们在那么出名时不会真正想到的后果的事……

lines.en: : Well, that...uhh...that put me into a pretty...unsafe position...
lines.zh: : 那......呃......那把我置于了一个相当......不安全的处境......

lines.en: : I kinda...may have had a bit of a...casting problem...
lines.zh: : 我大概……可能有点……选角方面的问题……

lines.en: : How...big of a problem, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体......多大的问题？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: It was...pretty bad...
scene utadormpanties17
: I was still learning, though! Like...there was a lot of stuff I had to figure out about...other stuff!
lines.zh: : 但我当时还在学！比如……有很多关于……别的东西的事我得搞清楚！

lines.en: : You didn’t have to-
lines.zh: : 你不用——

lines.en: : Those days are behind me now, though! I’m clean! I swear!
lines.zh: : 不过那些日子已经过去了！我干净了！我发誓！

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : It was just a series of bad decisions that snowballed into a lot of people getting hurt! Please don't hold that against me!
lines.zh: : 那只是一连串糟糕的决定滚雪球，最后害很多人受了伤！请别因此怪我！

lines.en: : Oh my god.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties18
: Hahah...I said that I wouldn’t give you any specifics but, here I am, about to give you {i}all{/i} the specifics because I don’t want to cause any misunderstandings and...
lines.zh: : 哈哈......我说过不会告诉你任何细节的，可现在我却要把{i}全部{/i}细节都告诉你，因为我不想造成任何误会，而且......

lines.en: : You know, this story is a lot harder to tell to someone who isn’t family. I didn’t have to worry about any of {i}them{/i} leaving me because of stupid choices I made.
lines.zh: : 你知道，这个故事跟不是家人的人讲要难得多。我不用担心{i}他们{/i}会因为我的蠢选择离开我。

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about me leaving you, either. Probably.
lines.zh: : 你也不用担心我会离开你。大概吧。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties27
: And now your {i}phone{/i} is going off?! You should know you’re supposed to silence your phone during heart-to-hearts with a secret catgirl! You really {i}are{/i} going to leave me!
lines.zh: : 现在你的{i}手机{/i}还响了？！你该知道，跟一个秘密猫娘交心的时候手机要静音！你是{i}真的{/i}要离开我了！

lines.en: : It’s probably just Ami asking when I’ll be home for dinner.
lines.zh: : 大概只是 Ami 问我什么时候回家吃晚饭。

lines.en: : Damn that accountant and her unflappable customer service! We’re supposed to be having a moment here!
lines.zh: : 该死的会计和她那副雷打不动的客户服务态度！我们本该在这儿有个温情时刻的！

lines.en: scene black
I tap on my recent messages, expecting Ami’s name to show up at the top of the queue.
lines.zh: 我点开最近的消息，以为队列最上方会出现 Ami 的名字。

lines.en: But what I find is something completely unexpected.
lines.zh: 可我看到的却完全出乎意料。

lines.en: : Sensei? Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : Sensei？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties28h
: Is it Ami like you expected? Or is it Noriko asking when you’re going to return all of her vegetables?
lines.zh: : 是如你所料的 Ami 吗？还是 Noriko 在问你什么时候把她所有的蔬菜还回去？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : It’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties29h
: Oh?
: Don’t tell me it’s Princess Maya summoning you for a quest to kill the demon lord??
lines.zh: : 别告诉我是 Maya 公主召唤你去执行杀死魔王的任务？？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties30h
: Let me see your phone. I know how to deal with-
lines.zh: : 让我看看你的手机。我知道该怎么处理——

lines.en: : Don’t.
lines.zh: : 别问。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties31h
: Huh?
: Don’t touch my phone. I need to have a conversation.
lines.zh: : 别碰我手机。我得跟人谈一谈。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...sure.
{i}Hi, Akira. This is American movie star, Seth Rogen. HAHAHAHAHA. You should read that in my voice.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}嗨，Akira。我是美国电影明星 Seth Rogen。哈哈哈哈哈哈。你该用我的声音读这句。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What do you want, Seth? Have you not tormented me enough?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你想干什么，Seth？你折磨我还不够吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}I just wanted you to tell Uta thanks for getting me that job in Pineapple Express!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我只是想让你替我谢谢 Uta，谢谢她帮我拿到《菠萝快车》那个角色！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}WHAT?{/i}
{i}Yeah! She was the casting director. That movie really propelled my career to the levels its reached now. You didn't know?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是啊！她就是选角导演。那部电影真的把我的事业推到了现在的高度。你不知道？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had no idea...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我完全不知道……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Bummer! Hope this doesn't ruin your relationship. HAHAHAHAHAHA. You should read that in my voice.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}真糟糕！希望这不会毁掉你们的关系。哈哈哈哈哈哈。你该用我的声音读这句。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'll take you down one day, Seth Rogen. I swear it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总有一天我要把你拉下来，Seth Rogen。我发誓。{/i}

lines.en: scene utadormpanties32
: I have to go.
lines.zh: : 我得走了。

lines.en: : What?...
: Did you...look up my IMDB page? Tell me you didn't. Not like I have one.
lines.zh: : 你……查了我的 IMDB 页面？告诉我你没查。反正我也不像有。

lines.en: : It was {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} did this to me.
lines.zh: : 是{i}你{/i}对我做了这个。

lines.en: : You just weren't very good, Sensei. You didn't even know the lines. You just kept making airplane noises.
lines.zh: : 你只是不太行，Sensei。你连台词都不知道。你只是一直发出飞机的声音。

lines.en: : IT'S CALLED IMPROV!
lines.zh: : 这叫即兴表演！

lines.en: scene komorebi1 with flash
We make our way into Io’s room to play checkers because I heard she is really good at it.
lines.zh: 我们走进 Io 的房间去下跳棋，因为我听说她下得特别好。

lines.en: Wow, there are a lot of pills in here. I wonder if that is where she gets her powers?
lines.zh: 哇，这里好多药片。不知道她的超能力是不是从那儿来的？

lines.en: The air is different this time around — and it’s not just because I’m not waking up in some gaudy bathrobe and faux-fur pajama pants.
lines.zh: 这次的空气不太一样——倒不只是因为我没有穿着那件俗气的浴袍和仿毛皮睡裤醒来。

lines.en: Maybe it’s the light — and that stale scent of turpentine. Maybe I'm high? Woah.
lines.zh: 也许是灯光——还有那股陈旧的松节油味。也许我嗑嗨了？哇。

lines.en: Whatever it is, it makes me want to fall asleep and never get up. Also, I am hungry.
lines.zh: 不管是什么，它让我想睡过去再也不起来。还有，我饿了。

lines.en: I want to collapse in her bed, fall asleep in her arms, then awake and brush her hair out of her face before going home and eating Cinnamon Toast Crunch.
lines.zh: 我想瘫倒在她床上，在她怀里睡着，然后醒来把她脸上的头发拨开，再回家吃肉桂吐司脆。

lines.en: I also really want to go swimming because the weather has been nice lately.
lines.zh: 我也特别想去游泳，因为最近天气很好。

lines.en: : You haven’t been here since you accidentally hugged Uta, have you?
lines.zh: : 自从你不小心抱了 Uta 之后，你就没来过这儿吧？

lines.en: : Not unless the two of you dragged me here after breaking into my house and hugging me while I slept. But that whole night is blurry to me because I'm high right now.
lines.zh: : 除非你们两个闯进我家、趁我睡觉时抱了我之后把我拖到这儿来。但那一整晚对我来说都很模糊，因为我现在嗑嗨了。

lines.en: scene komorebi2
: We kind of just showed up, freaked out, then got forced out of the house by your psychopath of a niece.
lines.zh: : 我们基本上就是来了，吓坏了，然后被你那个疯子侄女赶出了屋子。

lines.en: : I’m sure she was just trying to do my taxes.
lines.zh: : 我确定她只是想帮我报税。

lines.en: scene komorebi3
: So does that give {i}other{/i} people permission to capture you and hold you in captivity so long as they’re doing it out of what you’d call “the goodness of their heart?” Asking for a friend.
lines.zh: : 那是不是就意味着，只要{i}别人{/i}是出于你所谓的「一片好心」，他们就有权把你抓起来囚禁？替朋友问的。

lines.en: : Only if I can write it off as a business expense.
lines.zh: : 除非我能把它算作业务支出抵扣掉。

lines.en: : And now I’m even more confused because I can’t tell if you {i}want{/i} me to have handcuffs or if you're just being financially responsible.
lines.zh: : 现在我就更糊涂了，因为我分不清你是{i}想{/i}让我有手铐，还是你只是在财务上很负责。

lines.en: scene komorebi4
: Do you want to keep me here forever?
lines.zh: : 你想把我永远留在这儿吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. It sounds nice and all, but it also might make it really hard to go to the amusement park when you finally decide to take me there.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。听起来挺不错，但这样一来，等你终于决定带我去游乐园的时候，可能会变得很麻烦。

lines.en: : Not going to happen, loser.
lines.zh: : 不可能，废物。

lines.en: scene komorebi5
: Really?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！

lines.en: : Yeah. I hate you.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我恨你。

lines.en: : I’m just going to ignore all of that so I can continue to be excited! Heck yeah! Amusement park!
lines.zh: : 我就当没听到那些，好让我继续兴奋下去！太棒了！游乐园！

lines.en: : Don’t get {i}too{/i} excited. The fact that it’s an amusement park won’t change the fact that I will continue to hate you.
lines.zh: : 别{i}太{/i}兴奋。就算去的是游乐园，也改变不了我会继续恨你的事实。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter! I suck, which just means that we can suck together while participating in slightly less sucky activities!
lines.zh: : 没关系！我很烂，也就是说我们可以一起烂，同时参加一些稍微没那么烂的活动！

lines.en: scene komorebi6
: Works for me, Io.
lines.zh: : 我没意见，Io。

lines.en: : Sensei? Where are you going?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Bed. I’m high.
lines.zh: : 床。我嗑嗨了。

lines.en: scene komorebi7 with flash
: But we're supposed to play Checkers.
lines.zh: : 但我们该下跳棋啊。

lines.en: : We did. Which means you’re welcome to join me if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 是啊。所以你要是想一起，随时欢迎。

lines.en: : We already played?
lines.zh: : 我们已经下过了？

lines.en: : That’s right. I’ve seized control of the bed. This is my bed now.
lines.zh: : 没错。我已经夺取了床的控制权。现在这是我的床。

lines.en: scene komorebi8
: You’re allowed to do that?!
lines.zh: : 你还能这么干？！

lines.en: : I can do anything I want. I'm the huggy boy.
lines.zh: : 我想做什么都行。我是抱抱男孩。

lines.en: : Then, as the huggy girl, I hereby seize control of your heart and command that you leave behind however many fake girlfriends you have in favor of either me or Uta! Or both.
lines.zh: : 那我作为抱抱女孩，特此夺取你的心的控制权，并命令你抛下你所有的假女朋友，选择我或者 Uta！或者两个都选。

lines.en: : I don't have any girlfriends. But can I bring Ami along?
lines.zh: : 我没有任何女朋友。但我能带上 Ami 吗？

lines.en: scene komorebi9
: Ew, no. I’ll never get to see you if she’s there. She’s too clingy.
lines.zh: : 恶，不行。她在的话我就永远见不到你了。她太黏人了。

lines.en: : And you’re not?
lines.zh: : 你不是吗?

lines.en: : Not like {i}that.{/i} She’s genuinely creepy. I’m just annoying.
lines.zh: : 我{i}那种{/i}不算。她是真的让人发毛。我只是烦人而已。

lines.en: : She’s family, Io. I can’t just abandon her even if you {i}do{/i} seize control of my heart.
lines.zh: : 她是家人啊，Io。{i}就算{/i}你占领了我的心，我也不能就这么抛下她。

lines.en: scene komorebi10
: Then what good does seizing it even do in the first place? Besides, isn’t it sort of arbitrary to keep her close-by just because she’s an “accountant?” That word means literally nothing.
lines.zh: : 那夺取它到底有什么好处？再说，就因为她是个「会计」就把她留在身边，这不是挺随意的吗？那个词根本毫无意义。

lines.en: : Webster's dictionary defines an accountant as a person whose job is to keep, inspect, and analyse financial accounts.
lines.zh: : 韦氏词典把会计定义为从事保管、审查和分析财务账目工作的人。

lines.en: : I’m not here for my aunt. I’m here because this is where all of my stuff is.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿不是为了我姑姑。我来这儿是因为我所有的东西都在这儿。

lines.en: : Who said anything about your aunt?
lines.zh: : 谁提到你姑姑了？

lines.en: scene komorebi11
: She travels a lot.
lines.zh: : 她经常出差。

lines.en: : Where? Why? Who?
lines.zh: : 哪儿？为什么？谁？

lines.en: : Around? I don’t know. It’s a big city. And you’d have nothing to gain from meeting her anyway.
lines.zh: : 到处跑？我不知道。这城市挺大的。再说了，你见她也没什么好处。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : You don’t even know her name, though.
lines.zh: : 可你连她的名字都不知道啊。

lines.en: : I literally never understand you or Uta in the hug zone.
lines.zh: : 在抱抱区里，我字面意义上从来搞不懂你或者 Uta。

lines.en: scene komorebi12
: Was that not immediately obvious?
lines.zh: : 这难道不是显而易见的吗？

lines.en: : {i}Sigh.{/i}
: Because I want to keep my life with you separate from my life outside of you.
lines.zh: : 因为我想把我跟你在一起的生活，和我之外的生活分开。

lines.en: : That’s not really how having a life with someone works, Io. You can’t just hide things from me forever.
lines.zh: : 和一个人共同生活不是这么回事，Io。你不可能永远对我藏着掖着。

lines.en: : Sure I can. But that’s fine because it means you can also hide things from me, so we don’t accidentally start mixing traumas and make our relationship all messy and sad like everything else in our lives.
lines.zh: : 我当然能。不过这也挺好的，因为这意味着你也可以对我藏着掖着，这样我们就不会不小心把各自的创伤搅在一起，把我们的关系弄得跟生活里其他事情一样又乱又丧。

lines.en: : But what if I want to share something with you? Like tapas.
lines.zh: : 但如果我想跟你分享点东西呢？比如西班牙小吃。

lines.en: : Then you can. I just don’t want it to be mandatory.
lines.zh: : 那你可以分享。我只是不希望它变成强制的。

lines.en: : I’m not proposing we make it “mandatory.” I’m proposing that we get tapas.
lines.zh: : 我不是提议把它变成「强制性的」。我是提议我们去吃西班牙小吃。

lines.en: : If you meet her, you’ll meet her. If you don’t, you won’t. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 你要是见她，就会见到。见不到，就见不到。就这么简单。

lines.en: : It’s not like you’re missing out anything. She’s just some random woman with really bad fashion sense.
lines.zh: : 你也没错过什么。她不过是个品味糟糕透顶的普通女人。

lines.en: scene komorebi13 with flash
: She’s more than just “some woman.” She’s the person effectively raising you even though you are a college age woman going to the college I teach at.
lines.zh: : 她不只是「某个女人」。她实际上是把你养大的人，哪怕你是个在我任教的那所大学读书的大学生年纪的女人。

lines.en: : And if she isn’t doing anything wrong, it’s messed up to just {i}reduce{/i} her to that.
lines.zh: : 而如果她没做错任何事，把她{i}简化{/i}成那个样子就很过分。

lines.en: : How is it messed up? It’s not like I’m calling her an evil witch. I’m just saying she is a human being who exists and that you don’t have a good reason to meet her. Which is true.
lines.zh: : 那怎么过分了？我又没说她是邪恶的女巫。我只是说她是个存在的人类，而你没有充分的理由去见她。这是事实。

lines.en: : You’re right. That {i}is{/i} true. I don’t have to meet her. I’ve gotten along just fine without her and I am perfectly content never coming into contact with a woman whose clothes I wore.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。{i}确实{/i}是事实。我不必见她。没有她我也过得挺好的，而且我完全满足于永远不去接触一个——我穿过的衣服都属于她的女人。

lines.en: : But, as someone currently reevaluating just what it means to be part of a “football team,” I have a problem with you talking about her like that.
lines.zh: : 但是，作为一个正在重新评估「橄榄球队」一员意味着什么的人，我无法接受你那样谈论她。

lines.en: : Football? You started a team and didn't invite me?
lines.zh: : 橄榄球？你组了个队却没邀请我？

lines.en: scene komorebi14 with flash
: Do you have any idea how hard “just being there” is?
lines.zh: : 你知道「就在那儿」有多难吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}not{/i} hard? I'd be a great cornerback. I'm really fast and agile.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}不难{/i}吧？我会是个很棒的角卫。我跑得很快，也很灵活。

lines.en: : Just look at how I’ve acted at essentially every single class gathering that we’ve ever-
lines.zh: : 看看我在我们每一次班级聚会上的表现就——

lines.en: : Just being a cornerback is way different than being a parent.
lines.zh: : 只当角卫跟当父母差得远了。

lines.en: : Cool. Except she {i}isn’t{/i} a parent. She’s my {i}aunt.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好酷哦。可她又{i}不是{/i}家长。她是我{i}姑姑{/i}。

lines.en: : Is she there for you when you need her? Is she good at doing the hug move?
lines.zh: : 你需要她的时候她在吗？她擅长那个抱抱动作吗？

lines.en: : She is, but-
lines.zh: : 是她，但是——

lines.en: : Then she’s a parent. She’s your mother.
lines.zh: : 那她就是家长。她就是你妈。

lines.en: scene komorebi15 with flash
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : Maybe I was wrong when I asked you if you knew how hard it was to “just be there.” What I should have asked is if you want to play checkers.
lines.zh: : 也许我问你知不知道「只是待在那儿」有多难，是我问错了。我该问的是你想不想下跳棋。

lines.en: : What’s going on with you? You said we already played. Are you just {i}trying{/i} to start a fight with me or something?
lines.zh: : 你怎么了？你说我们已经下过了。你是{i}故意{/i}想跟我吵架还是怎么的？

lines.en: : What’s going on is that I think you’re taking your aunt for granted and that isn’t fair to her. She doesn’t {i}have{/i} to look after you, but she does. And she gives you everything you need, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 我是觉得你把姑姑的付出当成了理所当然，这对她不公平。她{i}没有{/i}义务照顾你，可她照顾了。而且她给了你一切需要的东西，不是吗？

lines.en: : I could look after myself if I had to. I'm on Etsy now.
lines.zh: : 要是非这样不可，我能照顾自己。我现在在 Etsy 上开店了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good for you. But not everyone can be on Etsy, Io. And if Ami had someone like her instead of someone like me, maybe fewer people would hate her for what she’s become.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那对你是好事。但不是每个人都能上 Etsy，Io。而如果 Ami 有像她那样的人、而不是像我这样的人，也许就会少些人因为她变成的样子而恨她。

lines.en: : Oh, so it’s a {i}personal{/i} thing. You’re coming after me because you regret {i}not{/i} opening an Etsy shop. Got it. That’s fine. I’ll be a scapegoat if it makes you feel better, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦，所以这是{i}个人{/i}的事。你冲我来是因为你后悔{i}没{/i}开 Etsy 店。明白了。没关系。如果这能让你好受点，我就当个替罪羊，Sensei。

lines.en: : I'm better at woodworking than you. My hands are so much bigger.
lines.zh: : 我木工比你好。我的手大得多。

lines.en: scene komorebi16
: You just want to tell me how I’m supposed to look at family because you’re pretending to be more than just Ami’s uncle now, right? And you want to feel better about the job you’re doing!
lines.zh: : 你只是想告诉我该怎么看待家人，因为你现在正假装自己不只是 Ami 的叔叔了，对吧？你想对自己正在做的这份工作感觉好一点！

lines.en: : Right?!
lines.zh: : 就是说啊！

lines.en: : No, that's not even remotely close.
lines.zh: : 不，差得远了。

lines.en: : Well I think it’s {i}cute{/i} that you want to play dress-up, Sensei! But maybe you should pretend to be something {i}other{/i} than a parent because parents are banned from online retail in Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得你想玩过家家很{i}可爱{/i}，Sensei！不过也许你该假装成父母{i}之外{/i}的东西，因为 Kumon-mi 禁止父母从事线上零售！

lines.en: : You’re right. There are so many strange laws here.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这里奇怪的法律太多了。

lines.en: : There’s no fixing that girl, Sensei. Just like there’s no fixing me! And I already {i}have{/i} an extended relative who inherited a role that, based on my experience, gets way more credit than it should for literally nothing!
lines.zh: : 那个女孩没救了，Sensei。就像我也没救了一样！而且我{i}已经{/i}有一个远房亲戚继承了一个角色，而根据我的经验，那个角色明明什么都没做，却得到了远超它应得的赞誉！

lines.en: scene komorebi14 with flash
: I’ll never get this fascination people have with {i}Five Nights at Freddy's.{/i} Like, oh! Congrats on being animatronics!
lines.zh: : 我永远搞不懂人们对{i}《玩具熊的五夜后宫》{/i}的痴迷。比如说，哦！恭喜你们成了机械玩偶！

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Shut up! I’m not finished! I need to tell you how fucking {i}stupid{/i} this topic is so we can go back to liking each other!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我还没说完！我得告诉你这个话题有多他妈的{i}愚蠢{/i}，这样我们才能回到互相喜欢的样子！

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : I said shut up!
lines.zh: : 我叫你闭嘴！

lines.en: scene komorebi17 with flash
: I don’t give a single CLUCK about what you want to be or what you think you {i}are,{/i} just keep Markiplier out of it!
lines.zh: : 我才一点也不鸡巴在乎你想当什么、你以为你{i}是{/i}什么，只要别把 Markiplier 扯进来！

lines.en: : I don’t {b}NEED{/b} family and I don’t {b}NEED{/b} to be reminded of how {b}EASY IT IS{/b} to cluck up {b}CHUCK-E-CHEESE{/b} okay?!
lines.zh: : 我{b}不{/b}需要家人，也{b}不{/b}需要被提醒把 {b}CHUCK-E-CHEESE{/b} 鸡巴搞砸有多{b}容易{/b}，行吗？！

lines.en: : Parents have {b}ONE CLUCKING JOB{/b} and it’s to {b}BE THERE.{/b} It isn’t hard! It’s really not! And I don’t {b}CARE{/b} that I’ve never experienced football because I don’t {b}HAVE{/b} to!
lines.zh: : 父母{b}只有一件鸡巴该做的事{/b}，那就是{b}在场{/b}。这又不难！真的不难！而且我{b}不在乎{/b}我从没体验过橄榄球，因为我{b}不{/b}需要！

lines.en: : Io, stop. I think you are becoming a chicken.
lines.zh: : Io，停下。我觉得你正在变成一只鸡。

lines.en: : And here {b}YOU{/i} are, playing a game of charades where you get to act out the role of a {b}POGCHAMP{/b} for the first time in your life, and you want {b}ME{/b} to be thankful for {b}SOMEONE ELSE{/b} playing too?!
lines.zh: : 而{b}你{/i}呢，正在玩一场你人生中第一次能扮演 {b}POGCHAMP{/b} 的猜词游戏，你却要{b}我{/b}感激{b}别人{/b}也在玩？！

lines.en: : Are you an {b}IDIOT?{/b} Are you {b}STUPID?!{/b} Or do you just {b}HATE{/i} grown women and get joy out of tormenting them?! Is {b}THAT{/b} why you’re doing this?! Is that your end goal here?! Are you one of {b}THEM{/b} now?!
lines.zh: : 你是{b}白痴{/b}吗？你是{b}蠢货{/b}吗？！还是你只是{b}恨{/i}成年女人、以折磨她们为乐？！{b}这就是{/b}你这么做的原因？！这就是你最终的目的？！你现在也是{b}他们{/b}之一了？！

lines.en: : One of who? I'm confused and scared again. Also I am still high.
lines.zh: : 谁之一？我又困惑又害怕了。还有我还是嗑嗨着。

lines.en: : Then {b}WHY?!{/b} Why would you press me about this?! Why would you call my {b}AUNT{/b} such a {b}TERRIBLE{/b} thing to my face?!
lines.zh: : 那{b}为什么{/b}？！你为什么要在这件事上逼我？！为什么要当着我的面，用那么{b}难听{/b}的话称呼我的{b}姑姑{/b}？！

lines.en: : You {b}DID{/i} hear, didn’t you?! {b}YOU HEARD WHAT THEY SAID ABOUT ME!{/b} That I’m {b}AGILE! FAST! FOOTBALL!{/b}
lines.zh: : 你{b}确实{/i}听到了，对吧？！{b}你听到他们怎么说我了！{/b}说我{b}灵活！快！橄榄球！{/b}

lines.en: scene komorebi18
: And you know it’s true...
lines.zh: : 而你知道那是真的......

lines.en: : But you have no idea what it’s like.
lines.zh: : 可你根本不知道那是什么感觉。

lines.en: : You’ve never felt like a prisoner...even when you {i}were{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有觉得自己是个囚犯......哪怕你真的{i}曾经是{/i}。

lines.en: : You’ve never been banned from Facebook.
lines.zh: : 你从来没被 Facebook 封过。

lines.en: : Never had to make up stories and excuses about why your homework was always wet!
lines.zh: : 从来不用编故事、找借口解释你的作业为什么总是湿的！
