lines.en: : And why it wasn't anything for someone to be concerned about! But it was! My house was flooded, Hugbert! FLOODED!
lines.zh: : 还有为什么那不值得别人担心！但它值得！我家被淹了，Hugbert！被淹了！

lines.en: : Someone should have done something! {b}SOMEONE SHOULD HAVE HELPED ME!{/b} But they didn’t! No one did! I don't know how to swim!
lines.zh: : 本该有人做点什么！{b}本该有人帮我！{/b}但他们没有！没人有！我不会游泳！

lines.en: : Are {b}THOSE{/b} the people you want me to feel sorry for?! The ones who let a little girl {b}FLOAT{/b} and {b}CRY{/b} because {b}THEY{/b} WERE AFRAID OF A LITTLE WATER?
lines.zh: : 你想让我同情的{b}就是{/b}那些人吗？！那些因为{b}自己{/b}怕一点水，就任由一个小女孩{b}漂着{/b}、{b}哭着{/b}的人？

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} no parents. Not anymore.
lines.zh: : 我{i}没有{/i}父母。已经没有了。

lines.en: : I have checkers and that’s it.
lines.zh: : 我只有跳棋，就这些。

lines.en: : And if you want me to start seeing that as anything else, you should grab me a bucket because that's where I'm gonna keep all the pieces I'm gonna steal from you.
lines.zh: : 而如果你想让我开始把那看成别的东西，你该给我拿个桶，因为我要从你这儿偷的所有棋子都会放在那儿。

lines.en: scene komorebi19
: Do you want to know how old I was?
lines.zh: : 你想知道我那时候多大吗？

lines.en: : When you learned to play checkers?
lines.zh: : 你学会下跳棋的时候？

lines.en: : Are you just lying to me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在骗我吗？

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 聊什么？

lines.en: : What were you doing with that picture of Seth Rogen?
lines.zh: : 你拿那张 Seth Rogen 的照片干什么？

lines.en: scene komorebi20
: What...picture of Seth Rogen?...
lines.zh: : 什么……Seth Rogen 的照片？……

lines.en: : You know exactly what I’m talking about...
lines.zh: : 你很清楚我在说什么......

lines.en: : It wasn’t just a misunderstanding...that was all typical wishful thinking from typical Io...
lines.zh: : 那根本不是什么误解......那全都是典型的 Io 式的一厢情愿......

lines.en: : I mean...what’s there to even misunderstand? You’re just another sick adult who can’t control himself around American comics. And I’m so clucked up by now that it barely even bothers me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我是说……有什么好误会的？你不过是又一个在美国喜剧演员面前控制不住自己的变态成年人。而我现在已经鸡巴烂透了，这事都几乎不再让我烦了。

lines.en: : You're chickening again. Please stop.
lines.zh: : 你又开始鸡化了。请停下。

lines.en: : But Seth Rogen...
lines.zh: : 可是 Seth Rogen……

lines.en: : Those pictures ruined Uta's life.
lines.zh: : 那些照片毁了 Uta 的人生。

lines.en: : And you’re keeping one as a...fucking trophy.
lines.zh: : 而你还留着一张当......他妈的战利品。

lines.en: : How...did you even...
: It doesn’t matter...Nothing matters...I’m done...
lines.zh: : 无所谓了......什么都不重要了......我放弃了......

lines.en: : Done with {i}what,{/i} Io?...
: Everything.
lines.zh: : 一切。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want to my floor. I won’t fight back.
lines.zh: : 你想对我的地板做什么都行。我不会反抗。

lines.en: scene komorebi21 with flash
: Did you hear that, Aki-kun? She says she won’t fight back. You can finally deep clean this place.
lines.zh: : 你听到了吗，Aki 君？她说她不会反抗。你终于可以彻底打扫这个地方了。

lines.en: : My Indigo...
scene komorebi22
: Hm?
: I've come to find the flower which blossoms...like a saint dying upside down...
lines.zh: : 我前来寻找那朵绽放得......像倒悬而死的圣徒一般的花......

lines.en: scene komorebi23
: Ahh, yes. Five Nights at Freddy's.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。《玩具熊的五夜后宫》。

lines.en: scene komorebi24
: Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧?

lines.en: : It could be good for her, you know.
lines.zh: : 这对她也许是好事，你知道的。

lines.en: : It could be good for you too.
lines.zh: : 对你也可能是好事。

lines.en: : Maybe it'll help sober you up?
lines.zh: : 也许这能帮你清醒点？

lines.en: : You’re like me when it comes to this stuff, Aki-kun. And we both know you’ve always looked up to me.
lines.zh: : 这种事上你跟我一样，Aki 君。而且我们俩都知道，你一直都很崇拜我。

lines.en: : I won’t tell you what to do — just that you should follow {i}your{/i} heart instead of someone else’s.
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉你该怎么做——只想说，你应该遵从{i}自己{/i}的内心，而不是别人的。

lines.en: : And if you think that cleaning this room will do her more good than it will harm, I say do it.
lines.zh: : 而如果你觉得打扫这个房间对她利大于弊，我说那就做吧。

lines.en: : You’ve always been a special boy. You can clean anything you want so long as you put your mind to it.
lines.zh: : 你一直都是个特别的男孩。只要下定决心，你想打扫什么都行。

lines.en: : This floor is no exception.
lines.zh: : 这块地板也不例外。

lines.en: : But {i}you{/i} have to make the decision, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : 但{i}你{/i}必须自己做这个决定，Aki 君。

lines.en: : It has to be {i}you{/i} this time.
lines.zh: : 这一次，必须是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Checkmate, Io.
lines.zh: : 将死，Io。

lines.en: : Do you even know how to play?!
lines.zh: : 你到底会不会下？！

lines.en: scene welcometothebucketscene1 with flash
: Welcome to Good Burger, home of the good burger. Can I take your order?
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到好汉堡，好汉堡之家。可以为您点单了吗？

lines.en: : I am me.
lines.zh: : 我是我。

lines.en: : And I am joined here today by Mayo.
lines.zh: : 今天和我一起在这儿的是 Mayo。

lines.en: scene welcometothebucketscene2
$ renpy.pause(2, hard=True)
scene welcometothebucketscene1
: Sorry. Moyo.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。是 Moyo。

lines.en: : I get the names confused sometimes because we are around condiments so often.
lines.zh: : 我有时候会把名字搞混，因为我们太常待在调味料旁边了。

lines.en: : It’s quite similar to the way you are always around milk.
lines.zh: : 这跟你总是待在牛奶旁边很像。

lines.en: : Think back to the first glass you ever drank.
lines.zh: : 回想你喝的第一杯。

lines.en: : Do you wish to hold it all again?
lines.zh: : 你想把这一切再握一次吗？

lines.en: : It was really smooth and delicious, right?
lines.zh: : 它真的很顺滑、很美味，对吧？

lines.en: : We are here under special guidance from the Produce Delivery Administration. Milk is a vegetable now.
lines.zh: : 我们是奉农产品配送管理局的特别指导来这儿的。牛奶现在是蔬菜了。

lines.en: : Three fluid ounces poured over ice is all you need to meet the daily calcium requirement.
lines.zh: : 倒在冰上三液量盎司，就够你满足每日钙需求了。

lines.en: : Tell me. Are you happy where you stand now? That milkless void.
lines.zh: : 告诉我。你对你现在站的位置满意吗？那个没有牛奶的虚空。

lines.en: : Happy to hear my voice?
lines.zh: : 听到我的声音，幸福吗？

lines.en: : Or is there something else you’d rather hear instead?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你更想听见别的什么？

lines.en: : Perhaps our daily specials and how much money you can save by ordering two of the same item instead of just one?
lines.zh: : 也许是我们今日特惠，以及点两份同样的东西而不是一份能省多少钱？

lines.en: : Help! There aren't any Patreon friendly shots of me in this scene!
lines.zh: : 救命！这个场景里没有任何适合 Patreon 的我的镜头！

lines.en: scene welcometothebucketscene4 with flash
: I suppose you’re wondering, “What even {i}is{/i} the Huggy Boy?”
lines.zh: : 我猜你在想，「抱抱男孩{i}到底{/i}是什么？」

lines.en: : But as you harken back to prior experiences you may or may not have had, you’ll come to find that the pieces don’t quite fit.
lines.zh: : 可当你回想起那些你也许有过、也许没有过的过往经历，你会发现这些碎片并不太吻合。

lines.en: : Is it really {i}you{/i} who should hold the Huggy Goblet at the end of next month? Or is there someone who has amassed more hugs within this fiscal quarter?
lines.zh: : 下个月月底真的该由{i}你{/i}来捧抱抱圣杯吗？还是有人在这个财季里积累了更多抱抱？

lines.en: : This is all because my hug gloves keep getting cut up!
lines.zh: : 这一切都是因为我的抱抱手套老是被剪坏！

lines.en: : That someone with scissors is sneaking into your room at night and cutting up your hug gloves without asking for your permission.
lines.zh: : 那个拿着剪刀的人会趁夜溜进你的房间，不经你同意就剪坏你的抱抱手套。

lines.en: : I pose a simple question of philosophy- one that an intellectual like you should be able to answer even if your wires are currently tangled.
lines.zh: : 我提出一个简单的哲学问题——像你这样的知识分子，就算现在线路有点缠成一团，也应该答得上来。

lines.en: : The question is this.
lines.zh: : 问题是这样的。

lines.en: : Is the dress blue and black or white and gold?
lines.zh: : 那条裙子是蓝黑还是白金？

lines.en: : Oh man. That's a hard one.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪。这题可真难。

lines.en: scene tree3 with flash
scene welcometothebucketscene5 with flash
: It’s raining outside. You are holding baseball cards.
lines.zh: : 外面在下雨。你手里拿着棒球卡。

lines.en: : You saw?
lines.zh: : 你看到了？

lines.en: : On your left, the sound of a stereo’s static screaming- no. {i}Singing{/i} to your senses.
lines.zh: : 在你的左边，是音响的静电在尖叫——不，是在对你的感官{i}歌唱{/i}。

lines.en: : One, two, three, four, five. Everybody in the car, so come on, let's ride.
lines.zh: : 一、二、三、四、五。大家都上车，来吧，我们走。

lines.en: : To the liquor store around the corner. The boys say they want some gin and juice, but I really don't wanna.
lines.zh: : 去街角的酒铺。男孩们说他们想来点金酒和果汁，但我真的不想去。

lines.en: : Who gave you my playlist? That's supposed to be confidential.
lines.zh: : 谁把我的歌单给你的？那本该是保密的。

lines.en: scene tree3 with flash
scene welcometothebucketscene8 with flash
: It is, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 确实很好，不是吗？

lines.en: : But keeping it confidential does little when we {i}all{/i} know your playlist is little more than Radio Disney's 2000 top hits.
lines.zh: : 但既然{i}我们大家{/i}都知道你的歌单不过是迪士尼电台 2000 年的热门金曲，保密也没什么用。

lines.en: : The pole to your left has never been touched.
lines.zh: : 你左边那根杆从来没被碰过。

lines.en: : Boop. Just touched it.
lines.zh: : 啵。刚碰了。

lines.en: : Let me try again. The one to your right has never been-
lines.zh: : 让我再试一次。你右边那根从来没被——

lines.en: : Boop. Touched that one too.
lines.zh: : 啵。那根也碰了。

lines.en: : Ugh. Moyo, please disinfect the poles.
lines.zh: : 呃。Moyo，请把杆子消毒一下。

lines.en: : Boop. I touched them too.
lines.zh: : 啵。我也碰了。

lines.en: : Am I the only one here who refuses to touch that which shan't be touched?
lines.zh: : 难道我是这儿唯一一个拒绝碰那些不该碰的东西的人？

lines.en: : Either way, you need red meat to become strong. How long are you going to look at the menu for?
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，你需要红肉才能变强。你还要看菜单看多久？

lines.en: : Don’t know! Haven’t learned words yet!
lines.zh: : 不知道！还没学会认字！

lines.en: : Then I suppose it wouldn’t hurt to give you a little hint.
lines.zh: : 那我想，给你一点小提示也无妨。

lines.en: : The universe is a forest.
lines.zh: : 宇宙是一片森林。

lines.en: : We are the soil.
lines.zh: : 我们是土壤。

lines.en: scene circle with flash
: And burgers are circular. Please order now. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 而且汉堡是圆形的。请现在点单。谢谢。

lines.en: scene tree3 with flash
scene welcometothebucketscene11 with flash
: I think he just wants an application. He looks nervous.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他只是想要一份申请表。他看起来很紧张。

lines.en: : Oh, right. The real reason we’re here today is because we need your help.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。我们今天来这儿的真正原因是我们需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : And because, unfortunately, the past several employees we’ve had in our store have lacked the necessary...{i}components{/i} required to fill the bucket.
lines.zh: : 而且因为，很遗憾，我们店过去几个员工都缺少装满那个桶所需的必要……{i}部件{/i}。

lines.en: : How come I have to do it? I don’t even like buckets.
lines.zh: : 为什么非得我来？我又不喜欢桶。

lines.en: : We need milk since we make our own cheese in house.
lines.zh: : 我们需要牛奶，因为我们的奶酪是自家做的。

lines.en: : Behind you is a cow. Please grab its utters and splish splash them into the milk bucket.
lines.zh: : 你身后有头牛。请抓住它的乳房，把奶噗噗地挤进奶桶里。

lines.en: : Utters?
lines.zh: : Utters？

lines.en: : They're like glove fingers but attached to cows. I'm sorry if the glove thing brings up bad memories.
lines.zh: : 它们就像手套的手指，只不过是长在牛身上的。如果「手套」这个词勾起了不好的回忆，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : I like the way the utters feel in my hands.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢乳房在我手里的感觉。

lines.en: : I think it's kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有点恶心。

lines.en: : Wait, no.
lines.zh: : 等等，不要。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看到没?

lines.en: : Don’t wanna milk the cow. Wanna hug Long Maya.
lines.zh: : 不想挤牛奶。想抱 Long Maya。

lines.en: scene tree3 with flash
scene welcometothebucketscene12 with flash
: {i}Long{/i} Maya?
lines.zh: : {i}长条{/i} Maya？

lines.en: : You. Like Maya, but longer. Stretchy limbs.
lines.zh: : 你啊。像 Maya，但是更长。四肢能拉长。

lines.en: : Me?
: But I'm the manager.
lines.zh: : 但我是经理。

lines.en: : Let me practice my gloveless hug or I'll give you a bad Yelp review.
lines.zh: : 让我练习我不戴手套的抱抱，不然我就给你个差评。

lines.en: scene welcometothebucketscene13
: You’re gross. I can't believe you wore a beer helmet here.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。我不敢相信你戴着啤酒头盔来这儿。

lines.en: : Look, Jessica! I found the milk!
lines.zh: : 看，Jessica！我找到牛奶了！

lines.en: scene welcometothebucketscene22 with flash
: MMGRGLRGRGRGLLGLRLGRGRGRGGGGRLLLLLLLLLL!
lines.zh: : MMGRGLRGRGRGLLGLRLGRGRGRGGGGRLLLLLLLLLL!

lines.en: : Moyo, you're not supposed to use my real name in public. I have a reputation to uphold.
lines.zh: : Moyo，你不该在公共场合用我的真名。我还有名声要维护。

lines.en: : Also, don't drink that. We need it for our homemade cheese.
lines.zh: : 还有，别喝那个。我们要用它做自制奶酪。

lines.en: scene welcometothebucketscene23
: (Airplane noises)
lines.zh: : (飞机声)

lines.en: scene makiclearnight1 with flash
: Have you noticed anything different about Makoto lately?
lines.zh: : 你最近有觉得 Makoto 有什么不一样吗？

lines.en: I wonder if it's about hiding cans of soup.
lines.zh: 不知道是不是关于藏汤罐头的事。

lines.en: : Something tells me this is about her hiding cans of soup.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉这是关于她藏汤罐头的事。

lines.en: : She keeps hiding cans of soup all over the place.
lines.zh: : 她老是把汤罐头藏得到处都是。

lines.en: : Maki, I’m not really sure I should be getting any further involved in anything that goes on between you and Makoto. It never really goes the way we want it to.
lines.zh: : Maki，我真不确定自己该不该更深地卷进你和她之间发生的任何事。它从来都不会按我们想要的方向走。

lines.en: : I kind of like it.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : I’m talking about how she’s been pretty great lately. She’s not sulking or sleeping in or anything like that. She's just...hiding soup. It's nice.
lines.zh: : 我说的是她最近相当不错。她不再闹别扭、也不睡懒觉什么的了。她就是……在藏汤。挺好的。

lines.en: : If...that’s what you’re talking about, then yes. I have noticed. I can’t imagine that’s what you called me out here to talk about, though.
lines.zh: : 如果......你说的是这个，那没错，我注意到了。不过我很难想象，你把我叫出来就是为了聊这个。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight2
: It is.
lines.zh: : 是我。

lines.en: : Oh.
: It’s no secret that I may have sidelined my own feelings when my husband died so Makoto wouldn’t be {i}completely{/i} without a parental figure, but...
lines.zh: : 我丈夫去世的时候，我大概是把自己的情绪搁到了一边，好让 Makoto 不至于{i}完全{/i}没有父母的角色——这也不是什么秘密，只是......

lines.en: : Now that she’s fine...I don’t know. Maybe all she's needed from the start is soup?
lines.zh: : 既然她好了……我不知道。也许她从一开始需要的就只是汤？

lines.en: : I’m just confused, I guess. About where to go from here and who I’m supposed to be and what I’m supposed to feel or...do. Like, should I join in? Or would that be weird?
lines.zh: : 我只是很困惑，我想。关于接下来该往哪走、我该是谁、我该感受什么或者……做什么。比如，我该加入吗？还是会很怪？

lines.en: : So...are you saying stress or...grief or something really {i}is{/i} what’s making you all...non-Maki?
lines.zh: : 所以......你是说，压力或者......悲伤之类的东西，{i}真的就是{/i}让你变得这么......不像 Maki 的原因？

lines.en: : It’s definitely not helping, I’ll tell you that much.
lines.zh: : 这点我可以说：它绝对没起好作用。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Despite how it might seem basically all the time, I {i}am{/i} an adult at the end of the day. And I can figure out ways to deal with stress and all that other lame adult stuff.
lines.zh: : 尽管基本上看起来一直都不是那么回事，但说到底我{i}是{/i}个成年人。我总能找到办法应对压力，还有那些无聊的大人烦恼。

lines.en: : There’s been something bothering me lately, though. Something that I’ve {i}never{/i} had to deal with. And, despite all of the experience in the world, I have no idea what to do about it.
lines.zh: : 不过最近有件事一直困扰我。一件我{i}从来{/i}不必处理的事。而且，尽管我有全世界最多的经验，我完全不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : And that is...somehow centered around Makoto’s weird soup-based hobby?
lines.zh: : 而那……不知怎么是围绕 Makoto 那个古怪的以汤为基础的爱好？

lines.en: scene makiclearnight3
: I know it probably sounds weird, but...{i}yeah.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道听起来大概很奇怪，不过......{i}是的{/i}。

lines.en: : She’s never been {i}this{/i} happy before. And the timing of it all is just really confusing to me since her dad didn't even like soup that much.
lines.zh: : 她以前从没{i}这么{/i}开心过。而这一切的时机让我特别困惑，因为她爸其实没那么喜欢汤。

lines.en: : Like, I’m not hoping she goes back to being miserable. I’m over the moon that she can get out of bed on her own now. I just think there’s...something more to this.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我并不希望她回到痛苦的状态。她能自己起床了，我高兴得不行。我只是觉得这背后……还有别的东西。

lines.en: : Like...you think it might be a front?
lines.zh: : 比如……你觉得那可能是装出来的？

lines.en: : What I’m saying is I think she’s the huggy girl.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我觉得她就是抱抱女孩。

lines.en: : Say whaaaaaaaat
lines.zh: : 你说什——么——

lines.en: : At the very least, she probably has a boyfriend or something. But the weirdest part of all of it is that I, Maki Miyamura, the huggy queen of the city-
lines.zh: : 至少，她大概有男朋友还是什么的。但最奇怪的一点是，我，Maki Miyamura，这座城市的抱抱女王——

lines.en: : Have absolutely no idea how to talk to her about it...
lines.zh: : 却完全不知道该怎么跟她开口谈这件事......

lines.en: : It’s crazy, isn’t it? You’d think that if {i}anyone{/i} could talk to their daughter about hugs, it would be me. But I've never even hugged my daughter.
lines.zh: : 这很疯，对吧？你会以为如果{i}有谁{/i}能跟自己女儿聊抱抱，那应该是我。可我连我女儿都没抱过。

lines.en: : I’ve been preparing for it for...basically {i}forever{/i} since I knew this day would come. Do you think I might {i}have{/i} to hug her? What if it gets weird?
lines.zh: : 我从知道这一天会来的时候就一直在准备……基本上{i}准备了永远那么久{/i}。你觉得我{i}可能{/i}得抱她吗？要是变怪了怎么办？

lines.en: : I just have no idea what to say to her. I feel totally useless in my very own area of expertise.
lines.zh: : 我就是完全不知道该跟她说些什么。在我自己的专业领域里，我感觉自己毫无用处。

lines.en: : Now, any time I think about hugs at all, I just start thinking about her. And then I start thinking about soup. And then I get hungry.
lines.zh: : 现在只要我一想到抱抱，就会开始想她。然后就开始想汤。然后就饿了。

lines.en: : Are you hungry too?
lines.zh: : 你也饿了吗？

lines.en: : What if I hugged her?
lines.zh: : 要是我去抱她呢？

lines.en: scene makiclearnight4
: Would you really do that for me?
lines.zh: : 你真的会为我那么做？

lines.en: : I...probably shouldn’t be weighing in on this.
lines.zh: : 我……大概不该在这事上发表意见。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight5
: That’s it, then? No hugs ever again? What has my family done to deserve this?
lines.zh: : 那就这样了？以后再也不抱了？我家人做了什么才摊上这种事？

lines.en: : Makoto’s smart. You probably don’t need to hug her if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : Makoto 很聪明。如果你不想，大概不必非抱她不可。

lines.en: : Makoto is smart, yes. But she’s also a {i}bat.{/i}
lines.zh: : Makoto 是很聪明。但她也是只{i}蝙蝠{/i}。

lines.en: If Makoto is a bat, does that make me Batman?
lines.zh: 如果 Makoto 是蝙蝠，那我是不是就成了蝙蝠侠？

lines.en: Is her hiding all of those cans of soup just her way of trying to build a nest?
lines.zh: 她把那些汤罐头全藏起来，是不是只是想筑个巢？

lines.en: How could I have been so blind?
lines.zh: 我怎么会这么瞎？

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Call me Doug.
lines.zh: : 叫我 Doug。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight6
: Hi, Doug.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Doug。

lines.en: : Hey, Patty.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Patty。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight7
: How about Dig-Dug instead? I love that game.
lines.zh: : 不如叫 Dig-Dug 吧？我很喜欢那个游戏。

lines.en: : Not as much as I love you.
lines.zh: : 没我爱你那么多。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight8
: Radical.
lines.zh: : 酷毙了。

lines.en: : Don’t think I’ll marry you just because you finally gave me your name, though. I still need to see you hug my daughter first.
lines.zh: : 不过别以为你终于给了我名字我就会嫁给你。我还得先看你抱我女儿。

lines.en: : I...don’t think I have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 我......觉得我不用担心那个。

lines.en: : You've already done it, haven't you?
lines.zh: : 你已经做过了，对吧？

lines.en: : It's hard to go to Hogwarts with someone without hugging them first. They say that in Prisoner of Azkaban.
lines.zh: : 跟人一起去霍格沃茨，很难不先抱一下对方。《阿兹卡班的囚徒》里是这么说的。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight9
: That was the worst one.
lines.zh: : 那是最差的一部。

lines.en: : Are you out of your flippin' mind? Sirius Black? Remus Lupin. Come on, Maki. Get with the program.
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗？天狼星·布莱克？莱姆斯·卢平。拜托，Maki。跟上节奏。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight10
: Everybody always yells at me when I say that.
lines.zh: : 我一说这个大家就都冲我吼。

lines.en: : Have better opinions and maybe that won't happen.
lines.zh: : 有点更好的观点，也许就不会了。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight11
: How about Star Wars? Name your favorite Star Wars movie on three. One, two, three-
lines.zh: : 那《星球大战》呢？数到三说出你最喜欢的星战电影。一、二、三——

lines.en: : Maki, I don't-
lines.zh: : Maki，我不——

lines.en: : Solo: A Star Wars Story.
lines.zh: : 《游侠索罗：星球大战外传》。

lines.en: : Listen, can we head back in now? I’m getting really tired of these weird takes.
lines.zh: : 听着，我们现在能回去吗？我真的受够这些奇怪的观点了。

lines.en: : We can't. Makoto's still hiding the soup.
lines.zh: : 不行。Makoto 还在藏汤。

lines.en: : She's {i}here?{/i}
lines.zh: : 她{i}在这儿{/i}？

lines.en: : Oh, shoot. That was supposed to be a secret.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。那本来该是秘密。

lines.en: scene makotoyay1 with flash
: I'm not a bat...
lines.zh: : 我不是蝙蝠……

lines.en: scene makotoyay2
: I'm not a bat...
lines.zh: : 我不是蝙蝠……

lines.en: scene black
scene makotoyay3 with flash
: I SWEAR TO GOD I'M NOT A BAT!
lines.zh: : 我向上帝发誓我不是蝙蝠！

lines.en: scene makotosadagain1
: Uhh...Makoto?
lines.zh: : 呃......Makoto?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : There’s someone here to see you.
lines.zh: : 有人来看你。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain2
: Sorry, but I’m not giving Batman any more hints.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但我不会再给蝙蝠侠任何提示了。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain3
: Well, I tried.
lines.zh: : 好吧,我试过了。

lines.en: : Did you really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : {i}Tried?{/i}
: Tried what?
lines.zh: : 试什么?

lines.en: : Getting hints. I know there's at least one more can somewhere in the living room. But-
lines.zh: : 收到提示。我知道客厅里至少还有一罐。但——

lines.en: : Did you think bringing him here would cheer me up?
lines.zh: : 你以为把他带过来我就会开心起来?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain4
: What? Of course not. Today's the family barbecue and the only day your father is allowed back from the-
lines.zh: : 什么？当然不是。今天是家庭烧烤，也是你爸唯一被允许从——回来的日子

lines.en: : Get out.
lines.zh: : 滚出去。

lines.en: : Makoto, please. Your father came all the way here from space and-
lines.zh: : Makoto，拜托。你爸从太空一路赶回来，而且——

lines.en: : Not him. You. Leave.
lines.zh: : 不是他。是你。出去。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain5
: You shouldn’t talk to your mother like that. She worked hard on organizing this event.
lines.zh: : 你不该那样跟你妈妈说话。她为了组织这个活动费了不少劲。

lines.en: : There's gonna be cornhole and everything.
lines.zh: : 还会有沙包洞游戏什么的。

lines.en: : I don't care.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。

lines.en: : And Sara is baking a cake and-
lines.zh: : 而且 Sara 在烤蛋糕，还有——

lines.en: : I told you, I don't care.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我不在乎。

lines.en: : Wow. All this just because you called her a bat.
lines.zh: : 哇。就因为你叫了她蝙蝠，就闹成这样。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain7
: {i}I'm not a bat.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不是蝙蝠。{/i}

lines.en: : Of course not, Makoto. You're just...bat {i}adjacent.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然不是，Makoto。你只是……跟蝙蝠{i}沾边{/i}。

lines.en: : What does that even {i}mean?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 那到底{i}是什么意思{/i}？！

lines.en: : Doug, you talk to her. I'm bad at this.
lines.zh: : Doug，你去跟她说。我不擅长这个。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain8
: I need to use the bathroom.
lines.zh: : 我得去趟洗手间。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain9
: Makoto! Tell this man where the bathroom is! I forgot!
lines.zh: : Makoto！告诉这个男人洗手间在哪儿！我忘了！

lines.en: : Nowhere! We don't have one!
lines.zh: : 哪儿都没有！我们没有洗手间！

lines.en: scene makotosadagain11
: Sorry, Sensdoug. Looks like you're just going to have to hold it in.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sensei Doug。看来你只好憋着了。

lines.en: : Mnhhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : Mnhhhhhhhhh...

lines.en: : Where is the fruit you were supposed to bring?!
lines.zh: : 你本该带的水果呢？！

lines.en: scene makotosadagain12
: The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : The fruit! For my diet! Do you {i}want{/i} me to starve?!
lines.zh: : 水果！给我节食用的！你{i}想{/i}饿死我吗？！

lines.en: : Oh, she's a {i}fruit{/i} bat. I thought she was one of the other ones.
lines.zh: : 哦，她是{i}果蝠{/i}。我以为她是别的种类。

lines.en: : Doug! How could you? My darling Makoto would never drink blood.
lines.zh: : Doug！你怎么能这样？我亲爱的 Makoto 绝不会吸血。

lines.en: : I am willing to branch out and try new things!
lines.zh: : 我愿意拓展一下、尝试新东西！

lines.en: : I stand corrected!
lines.zh: : 我认错！

lines.en: scene makotosadagain13
: I’ll take it from here, Maki. I have plenty of blood.
lines.zh: : 接下来交给我，Maki。我血多得是。

lines.en: : Thank goodness because I'm running low.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，因为我快用完了。

lines.en: : I only ask for one thing in return, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我只要一样回报，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain15
: Oh no. A reset is here. I'm scared and forgot what I was going to ask.
lines.zh: : 哦不。重置来了。我很害怕，忘了我本来要问什么。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain16
: You want my BTS calendar, don't you?
lines.zh: : 你想要我的 BTS 日历，对吧？

lines.en: : Just the later months. You can have the first six.
lines.zh: : 只要后面几个月。前六个月归你。

lines.en: : Wanna know what I really think, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 想知道我真正的想法吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : About BTS?
lines.zh: : 关于 BTS？

lines.en: : About all the hugs you've been having with girls less suited to being hugged than me.
lines.zh: : 关于你跟那些比我更不适合被抱的女孩们做的所有抱抱。

lines.en: : Fine, Makoto. If you can solve my riddle, I will declare you the huggy girl once and for all.
lines.zh: : 行，Makoto。如果你能解开我的谜语，我就一劳永逸地宣布你是抱抱女孩。

lines.en: : Bring it on, Doug.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Doug。

lines.en: : It has no arms. It has no mouth. It's not a frog. It's not a mouse.
lines.zh: : 它没有手臂。它没有嘴。它不是青蛙。它不是老鼠。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain17
: Hmmm...
scene makotosadagain18
: A flag! Paint! The ninth page of Salvador Plascencia's {i}The People of Paper!{/i}
lines.zh: : 一面旗！颜料！Salvador Plascencia 的{i}《纸人》{/i}第九页！

lines.en: : Tch. That's not fair. I didn't realize how many potential answers there were.
lines.zh: : 啧。这不公平。我没想到潜在答案有这么多。

lines.en: : Welcome to the party, Sensei. The seat at the head of the table is free now.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临这场派对,Sensei。桌子主位的位子现在空着。

lines.en: : I'd have to sit on your dad's lap, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，我得坐在你爸腿上。

lines.en: : I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you?...Sitty...boy.
lines.zh: : 我打赌你会喜欢的，对吧？……坐坐……男孩。

lines.en: : City boy?
lines.zh: : 城里男孩？

lines.en: : No, like...sitty. As in you sit. On a chair.
lines.zh: : 不，就是……坐坐。就是你坐。坐在椅子上。

lines.en: : I don't know what that means.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Liar.
lines.zh: : 骗子。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll sit. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我坐。谢了。

lines.en: : I knew it! Nothing you say is ever true!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！你说的从来没有一句是真的！

lines.en: scene makotosadagain19
: But you're really warm so I guess this is kind of okay.
lines.zh: : 不过你真的很暖，所以我想这样也还行。

lines.en: : Where's the soup, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 汤在哪儿，Makoto？

lines.en: : {i}Everywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}到处都是。{/i}

lines.en: : You know your mom is getting into that too, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你妈也开始搞那个了吧？

lines.en: : Wow, it’s almost like we’re related or something.
lines.zh: : 哇,简直像我们真有血缘关系似的。

lines.en: : You don’t actually dislike her, do you?
lines.zh: : 你其实并不讨厌她,对吧?

lines.en: : She called me a bat.
lines.zh: : 她叫我蝙蝠。

lines.en: : I like her a lot, actually. She reminds me of this one girl that’s been following me around like a bat since the school year began.
lines.zh: : 其实我很喜欢她。她让我想起一个从学年开始就像蝙蝠一样跟着我到处走的女孩。

lines.en: : You better not be talking about me.
lines.zh: : 你最好不是在说我。

lines.en: : I’m talking about you, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我说的显然是你。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain20
: Did she pay you to say that? Is that part of your {i}mission{/i} today?
lines.zh: : 她花钱让你这么说的吗?这是你今天的「{i}任务{/i}」的一部分?

lines.en: : If she did pay me to say that, you two would be even more alike. I know you two are always bribing the police.
lines.zh: : 如果她真付钱让我说那个，你们俩就更像了。我知道你们俩老是贿赂警察。

lines.en: : Well, excuse me for backing the blue.
lines.zh: : 那我为支持警察道个歉。

lines.en: : If you think this has any bearing on my decision to ultimately hug you, though...I think there’s a lot you don’t understand about this relationship.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你觉得这跟我最终抱不抱你的决定有什么关系……我觉得这段关系里有很多你不了解的东西。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not as if you make it easy to understand.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你也没让它变得容易理解啊。

lines.en: : If you're the huggy boy, why do you always need to be so secretive about hugs?
lines.zh: : 如果你真是抱抱男孩，你为什么老是要对抱抱这么神秘？

lines.en: : It's just that...hugs are special.
lines.zh: : 只是……抱抱很特别。

lines.en: : They're this thing you share with someone you love.
lines.zh: : 那是你跟所爱之人分享的东西。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain21
: Are you saying you...love me?
lines.zh: : 你是说……你爱我？

lines.en: : I don't know what I'm saying. I'm just kind of winging it since you won't give me any soup hints.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我在说什么。既然你不给我任何藏汤的提示，我就只是随口胡扯。

lines.en: : How should I know soup hints anyway? I can’t remember anything about where I hide stuff. That just shows how good I am at my job.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道藏汤的提示？我完全不记得我把东西藏在哪儿。这只能说明我干这行干得有多好。

lines.en: : I just want to know what I can do to make you start coming to school again. And I thought finding all of your nest pieces would do that.
lines.zh: : 我只想知道我该怎么做才能让你重新来上学。我以为把你筑巢的材料全找出来就能做到。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain23
: I see that you've discovered the motivation behind all these malicious actions.
lines.zh: : 看来你已经发现了这些恶意行为背后的动机。

lines.en: : You can't hide anything from the huggy boy, you...lucky...duck.
lines.zh: : 你什么都瞒不过抱抱男孩，你这……幸运……鸭子。

lines.en: : Lucky...
: Me...lucky...
: Me...the girl who just lost her one and only hero...
lines.zh: : 我......那个刚刚失去了自己唯一的英雄的女孩......

lines.en: : He's right downstairs.
lines.zh: : 他就在楼下。

lines.en: : I’m lucky...
: I’m so lucky...
lines.zh: : 我真是太幸运了......

lines.en: : Okay...{i}lucky{/i} definitely wasn’t the best word choice on my part. But I’m sure you understand what I mean, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 好吧......「{i}幸运{/i}」确实不是我该选的词。不过我相信你明白我的意思,对吧?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain24
: Of course I understand, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我当然明白,Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m {i}smart...{/i}remember?
lines.zh: : 我很{i}聪明{/i}的......记得吗?

lines.en: : Those little plastic tips on the ends of shoelaces...what do you think those are called?
lines.zh: : 鞋带末端那些小塑料头……你觉得那叫什么？

lines.en: : Aglets.
lines.zh: : 鞋带扣。

lines.en: : You only know that because you are also smart. Like me. We are both not bats.
lines.zh: : 你知道那个只是因为你也很聪明。像我一样。我们俩都不是蝙蝠。

lines.en: : Or maybe we're {i}all{/i} bats...and we just have the words for that and {i}human{/i} mixed up.
lines.zh: : 又或者我们{i}全都{/i}是蝙蝠……只是我们把「蝙蝠」和{i}「人类」{/i}这两个词搞混了。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain25
: {i}Who is ever gonna marry a bat?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谁会娶一只蝙蝠啊？{/i}

lines.en: : Batman, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是蝙蝠侠。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain26
: That’s clucking stupid.
lines.zh: : 这鸡巴蠢透了。

lines.en: : Have you been hanging out with Io?
lines.zh: : 你最近跟 Io 混在一起了？

lines.en: : Have {i}you{/i} been hanging out with Io? Because she just won the National Checkers Tournament.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}最近跟 Io 混在一起了？她刚赢了全国跳棋锦标赛。

lines.en: : I heard Seth Rogen was there and everything.
lines.zh: : 我听说连 Seth Rogen 都到场了。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain27
: I don't want to talk about that guy. He's a big meanie jerkpants.
lines.zh: : 我不想聊那家伙。他就是个大坏蛋讨厌鬼。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain28
: You...see him the same way I do?
lines.zh: : 你……也跟我一样看他的？

lines.en: : Does that surprise you?
lines.zh: : 这让你意外吗？

lines.en: : A little.
lines.zh: : 好一点了。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain29
: I guess that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。

lines.en: I recall an earlier thought — one about bees.
lines.zh: 我想起之前的一个念头——关于蜜蜂的。

lines.en: Buzz buzz buzz, so cute
lines.zh: 嗡嗡嗡，好可爱

lines.en: : Have I ever helped you with {i}anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我到底帮过你{i}什么{/i}吗?

lines.en: : Because all this time, I’ve been telling myself that what I’ve been doing for you was what was best. But I don’t know if I ever actually believed that or if I just...{i}made{/i} myself believe it.
lines.zh: : 因为一直以来,我都在告诉自己,我为你做的那些事都是为了你好。可我不知道自己是不是真的相信过,还是只是......{i}让{/i}自己相信了。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m asking is...do you need something different from me? Or...{i}want{/i} something different from me?
lines.zh: : 我想问的是......你需要我变得不一样吗?或者......{i}想要{/i}我变得不一样?

lines.en: : Should I be less Batman? {i}More{/i} Batman?
lines.zh: : 我该少一点蝙蝠侠？还是{i}多一点{/i}蝙蝠侠？

lines.en: scene makotosadagain30
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Have you ever lost someone you loved?
lines.zh: : 你曾经失去过你爱的人吗?

lines.en: : Haruka...every single day.
lines.zh: : Haruka……每一天。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront3 with flash
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Yumi punched so many old people today!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Chika 大姐！Yumi 今天揍了好多老人！

lines.en: : Punched? Or {i}hugged?{/i}
lines.zh: : 揍了？还是{i}抱了？{/i}

lines.en: : Ha ha ha, very funny. I like jokes because I'm a normal, comedy-loving girl
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈，真好笑。我喜欢笑话，因为我是个正常、爱看喜剧的女孩

lines.en: : Mhm. So, what are you doing here exactly?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。所以你到底来这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront4 with flash
: Looking for old people!
lines.zh: : 在找老人！

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi used a bad word! Now she has to stand still and let Chinami kick her in the teeth!
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐说了脏话！现在她得站着不动，让 Chinami 踢她的牙！

lines.en: : Go ahead, loser. I ain't no grandpa.
lines.zh: : 来啊，废物。我可不是什么老头子。

lines.en: : Is Noriko busy today? I feel like tying someone to a moving car. Just like, before it starts moving. And then it would start moving and take her with it.
lines.zh: : Noriko 今天忙吗？我想把谁绑在一辆正在开的车上。就是那种，趁它还没开动的时候绑。然后它就开动，把她一起带走。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront5
: The hell’s {i}your{/i} problem? Tough day at the tire factory?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}他妈什么毛病？轮胎厂今天活儿太累？

lines.en: : Papa lost his job and now big sis Chika needs to pick up the slack! Skeet skeet! Yahtzee!
lines.zh: : 爸爸丢了工作，现在得 Chika 大姐来顶上！Skeet skeet！Yahtzee！

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront6
: What did I tell you about that stupid new catchphrase?!
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过多少次别用那个蠢新口头禅？！

lines.en: : Rats! Big sis Yumi is too good at blocking! She should fight Chinami like a real man!
lines.zh: : 可恶！Yumi 姐姐太会挡了！她该像个真正的男子汉一样跟 Chinami 打！

lines.en: : You mean an {i}old{/i} man!
lines.zh: : 你是说{i}老{/i}头子吧！

lines.en: : Quickly if you can, Chinami. I only have twenty minutes left to live.
lines.zh: : 能快点就快点，Chinami。我只剩二十分钟好活了。

lines.en: : It’s whatever. I’ll just crash on the futon while you die. I don’t feel like stayin’ at the old place tonight. Too far.
lines.zh: : 随便吧。你死你的，我在被褥上凑合一晚。今晚我不想待在老地方。太远了。

lines.en: : Well, that sucks for you because you aren’t welcome here anymore.
lines.zh: : 那真不巧，因为这儿已经不欢迎你了。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront7
: What? Why? Rich girl gettin’ stingy with the leasing agreement or something? Was only a matter of time. They’re all like that.
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？大小姐开始抠租赁协议了还是怎么的？早晚的事。她们都那样。

lines.en: : No, Touka’s been an angel. I just don’t want you here anymore.
lines.zh: : 不是，Touka 一直像个天使。我就是不想让你再来了。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront8
: ...What?
: Is it because of all the old people she punched?
lines.zh: : 是因为她揍的那些老人吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. How many has it been now, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。到现在多少个了，Yumi？

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t know. A...billion?
lines.zh: : 呃……不知道。大概……十亿？

lines.en: : So many old people.
lines.zh: : 好多老人啊。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront9
: Yeah but they're all gonna be gone soon anyway and-
lines.zh: : 是啊，可他们反正很快就都没了，而且——

lines.en: : B...Big sis? I think you’re supposed to hug Yumi and tell her she's a good and normal comedy-loving girl.
lines.zh: : 大……大姐？我觉得你应该抱抱 Yumi，告诉她她是个善良又正常的爱看喜剧的女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah! Tell another joke and you'll see!
lines.zh: : 对！你再说个笑话试试！

lines.en: : Now why would I do that when big sis Yumi has no problem stabbing me in the back?
lines.zh: : 既然 Yumi 大姐背刺我一点都不手软，我干嘛还要那样做？

lines.en: scene black
: Hold on, hold on, hold on!
lines.zh: : 等等，等等，等等！

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront10 with flash
: The cluck is this about?
lines.zh: : 这鸡巴是闹哪出？

lines.en: : So Io got to you too...
lines.zh: : 所以 Io 也找上你了……

lines.en: : Chika, what's all this about stabbin’ you in the back? You’re like the one person I’m consistently good to.
lines.zh: : Chika，什么背刺不背刺的？你可是唯一一个我一直都对得起的人。

lines.en: : Chinami, cover your ears please. I'm about to sing that song you hate.
lines.zh: : Chinami，请把耳朵捂上。我要唱那首你讨厌的歌了。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront11 with flash
: Ch-Chinami has changed her mind! M-Maybe Old Town Road isn't so bad after all?!
lines.zh: : Ch-Chinami 改主意了！也、也许 Old Town Road 其实没那么糟？！

lines.en: : Gonna take my horse to the old town road, I'm gonna-
lines.zh: : 我要骑着我的马去老城路，我要——

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront12
: Aaaaaaaaaaaah no it's still bad.
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊不，还是很难听。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront13 with flash
: Does it intimidate you when I make one eye big and the other one small? I bet it does.
lines.zh: : 我一只眼睛睁大、一只眯小的时候，你会怕吗？我打赌你会怕。

lines.en: : This...This ain’t about money, is it? Because I can start payin’ you back for moochin’ off you for so long. I just figured the console was something that’d make the kid who isn't actually a kid happy and-
lines.zh: : 这……这不是为了钱吧？我可以开始还你钱，毕竟我蹭了你那么久。我只是觉得那台游戏机能逗那个其实不算小孩的小孩开心，而且——

lines.en: : You really think {i}I’d{/i} get grumpy-wumpy about {i}money?{/i} Me? Break me off a piece of that Kit-kat bar, sister. Ain't nobody got time for that.
lines.zh: : 你真以为{i}我{/i}会为了{i}钱{/i}闹小脾气？我？给我掰一块 Kit-kat 吧，姐妹。谁有那闲工夫。

lines.en: : I don't know how I'm supposed to take this. You've never been so grump-wumpy with me before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么理解。你以前从没对我发过这么大的小脾气。

lines.en: : You’ve got no clue I even know, do you?
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道我什么都知道了，是吧？

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront14
: Know what?! I ain’t hugged anybody!
lines.zh: : 知道吗？！我没抱过任何人！

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Not even my boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？连我男朋友也没抱过？

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront15
: Your...boyfriend?
: The {i}Huggy Boy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱抱男孩。{/i}

lines.en: : You're dating the Huggy Boy? But he's incapable of love.
lines.zh: : 你在跟抱抱男孩交往？可他根本不会爱人。

lines.en: : See, that’s what I thought too!
lines.zh: : 看吧，我以前也是这么想的！

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront16
: Up until I heard you guys hugging on the beach.
lines.zh: : 直到我听见你们在海滩上抱成一团。

lines.en: : You...
: You heard that?
lines.zh: : 你听到那句了？

lines.en: : Chinami is just thankful it wasn't dancing.
lines.zh: : Chinami 只是很庆幸那不是跳舞。

lines.en: : Why do you hug so loudly?
lines.zh: : 你抱人为什么那么大声？

lines.en: : It wasn’t what it looked like! I mean...sounded like!
lines.zh: : 不是看起来那样！我是说……不是听起来那样！

lines.en: : Not what it sounded like?! You specifically said “Hug me harder, Huggy Boy!” How else am I supposed to interpret that?!
lines.zh: : 不是听起来那样？！你明明说了「再抱紧点，抱抱男孩！」我还能怎么理解？！

lines.en: : O-Okay! How about we talk about this on the balcony? Get grumpy-wumpy at me out there instead!
lines.zh: : 好、好吧！要不我们去阳台谈这个？到外面再冲我发小脾气！

lines.en: : Fine! The weather's really nice today and it might calm me down
lines.zh: : 行！今天天气确实不错，说不定能让我冷静下来

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront17 with flash
: I LIED!
lines.zh: : 我骗你的！

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : How gullible do you think I am?! I’ve been watching you closer than anyone! Sometimes while you sleep!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我有多好骗？！我一直盯你盯得比谁都紧！有时候你睡觉的时候也盯！

lines.en: : WHY?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : Because I can sense you dreaming about hugs!
lines.zh: : 因为我能感觉到你在梦里抱人！

lines.en: : No! I mean I...uhh...well...
: Spit it out or someone’s going to be cleaning off the concrete down there, Yumi! Probably Sensei! He's starting a power washing business!
lines.zh: : 快说，不然待会儿有人得去清理下面那摊水泥地了，Yumi！大概是 Sensei！他正准备开个高压水枪清洗公司！

lines.en: : I think the concrete could use a good power wash!
lines.zh: : 我觉得那水泥地确实该好好冲一冲！

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront18
: I trusted you. I’m the {i}one{/i} person who has always had your back. Even when everyone else was like “Maybe we should ask Yumi to stop punching people?” I stood up for you!
lines.zh: : 我信过你。我一直是{i}唯一{/i}一个挺你的人。就算别人都在说「也许我们该让 Yumi 别再揍人了？」，我还是替你说话！

lines.en: : And this is my reward?! Finding out you’ve been hugging my boyfriend while I break my back trying to do gymnastics beneath the highway?!
lines.zh: : 这就是我的回报？！我拼了命在高速公路底下练体操，结果发现你一直在抱我男朋友？！

lines.en: : Just let me explain, Chika. It’s really not like- you've been doing gymnastics beneath the highway?
lines.zh: : 让我解释，Chika。真的不是——你一直在高速公路底下练体操？

lines.en: : I can't do it here! Chinami is allergic to athleticism.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿做不了！Chinami 对运动过敏。

lines.en: : {i}*Cough cough* Oh no! Is there an athlete around?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}*咳咳* 糟了！附近有运动员吗？！{/i}

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront19
: It’s...obviously true that you saw us together. But it was just one little meaningless hug. No strings attached.
lines.zh: : 你看到我们在一起……这当然是真的。但那只是一个毫无意义的小拥抱。没附带任何条件。

lines.en: : Liar. I know you've always wanted to be a ventriloquist. You never go anywhere without your dummy.
lines.zh: : 骗子。我知道你一直想当腹语师。你走到哪儿都带着你的木偶。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront20
: You'll {i}never{/i} be Jeff Dunham and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你{i}永远{/i}成不了 Jeff Dunham，你自己清楚。

lines.en: : That really hurts, Chika...
lines.zh: : 这话真伤人，Chika……

lines.en: : Not as much as this betrayal hurts me. Now I need to install cameras in Sensei's house so I can watch him sleep too. I can't afford that!
lines.zh: : 比不上这份背叛伤我伤得深。现在我得在 Sensei 家里装摄像头，好让我也能看他睡觉。可我付不起！

lines.en: : I can help pay? Old people normally have cash on them. It's not much, but it's something.
lines.zh: : 我能帮着出点钱？老人身上一般都带现金。不多，但总归是点钱。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront21
: You take their money too?
lines.zh: : 你还拿他们的钱？

lines.en: : I need to eat!
lines.zh: : 我得吃饭啊！

lines.en: : I’m not buying it, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我不买账，Yumi。

lines.en: : I know! I am!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我买！

lines.en: : At the end of the day, I heard you two hugging it up in a non-hug zone. I heard you ask to go back to his room. Were you gonna hug there too?
lines.zh: : 说到底，我听见你们俩在一个禁止抱抱的区域里抱得火热。我听见你说要回他房间。你是不是打算在那儿也抱？

lines.en: : No! He was going to show me the blanket he crocheted for you!
lines.zh: : 不是！他是要给我看你那条他亲手钩的毯子！

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront22
: So now he thinks I can't regulate my own body temperature? What have you done?
lines.zh: : 所以现在他觉得我自己调不了体温？你都干了什么？

lines.en: : I didn’t want to do anything to hurt you, Chika...I just know you get chilly sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我不想做任何伤害你的事，Chika……我只是知道你有时会觉得冷。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not very comforting to hear that the only thing preventing you from hugging my boyfriend is the weather.
lines.zh: : 听说唯一拦着你抱我男朋友的东西是天气，这可不太让人安心。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront23
: I {i}love{/i} him. You got that? And even if the Huggy Boy is incapable of love, I know he loves me too.
lines.zh: : 我{i}爱{/i}他。听明白了吗？就算抱抱男孩不会爱人，我也知道他也爱我。

lines.en: : And you want to know what’s really crazy? I’d {i}still{/i} love him even if he hugged you a hundred times that night because {i}you{/i} probably begged for it.
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么才叫真疯吗？就算那晚他抱了你一百次，我也{i}照样{/i}爱他，因为八成是{i}你{/i}求来的。

lines.en: : I like the way his shirt feels. It's so thick and soft.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢他衬衫的手感。又厚又软。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront24
: I know that! But no amount of mentally preparing myself and tricking myself into thinking I have a perfect relationship could have prepared me for {i}this!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道！可不管我怎么在心里打腹稿、怎么骗自己说我这段感情很完美，都没法让我为{i}这个{/i}做好准备！

lines.en: : Only {i}I{/i} am supposed to touch his super thick and soft shirt! Nobody else! Me! The huggy girl!
lines.zh: : 只有{i}我{/i}才能碰他那件超厚超软的衬衫！别人都不行！是我！抱抱女孩！

lines.en: : You're not the huggy girl, Chika...there {i}is{/i} no huggy girl.
lines.zh: : 你不是抱抱女孩，Chika……根本{i}没有{/i}什么抱抱女孩。

lines.en: : Don't say that! Don't say things you can't take back!
lines.zh: : 别那么说！别说这种收不回去的话！

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront25
: Zzzzzzzzzzz...
lines.zh: : Zzzzzzzzzzz...

lines.en: : Did you just fall asleep? Or are you just pretending to be asleep to avoid confrontation?
lines.zh: : 你刚才是睡着了？还是只是在装睡，好躲开对质？

lines.en: : Yumi eepy. Bye bye.
lines.zh: : Yumi 困困。拜拜。

lines.en: : I still can't tell if this is an act. Your skills are unbelievable.
lines.zh: : 我还是分不清这是不是演的。你这演技简直了。

lines.en: : Snoooooore. Zzzzzzzzz.
lines.zh: : 呼噜噜噜噜噜。Zzzzzzzzz。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront26
: Good morning. How long was I out?
lines.zh: : 早上好。我睡过去多久了？

lines.en: : Like five seconds?
lines.zh: : 大概五秒？

lines.en: : Wow. Are all of our problems solved yet?
lines.zh: : 哇。我们的问题都解决了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Let's go get ice cream and punch old people together.
lines.zh: : 解决了。走，我们一起去吃冰淇淋、揍老人。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront27
: You'd really do that for me? Even after I hugged your boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 你真愿意为我这么做？就算我抱了你男朋友？

lines.en: : Yes. It just means I have to hug him better. I will win this hug competition whether you believe in me or not. Mark my words.
lines.zh: : 愿意。这只说明我得抱得更好。不管你信不信我，这场抱抱比赛我都会赢。你记住我这话。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront25
: Zzzzzzzz...
lines.zh: : Zzzzzzzz...

lines.en: : Rats. She's out again.
lines.zh: : 啧。她又睡过去了。

: I am going to feed so many rabbits today.
lines.zh: : 今天我要喂好多好多兔子。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut2
: Hello, Tsuneyo. I am here to collect the food for the rabbits.
lines.zh: : 你好，Tsuneyo。我来收喂兔子的食物。

lines.en: : Please wait one moment. I am almost done.
lines.zh: : 请稍等一下。我就快好了。

lines.en: : Yes.
: Not you! Someone else!

lines.en: : No.

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut9 with flash
: No?
lines.zh: : 没有吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Just me.
lines.zh: : 没有。就我一个。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut10
: Where is the huggy boy? He will know how to calm me down.
lines.zh: : 抱抱男孩在哪儿？他会知道怎么让我冷静下来。

lines.en: : The huggy boy hasn't existed for 5,000 years.
lines.zh: : 抱抱男孩已经五千年没存在过了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut11
: No...that can't be true. I saw him just yesterday.
lines.zh: : 不……那不可能。我昨天才见过他。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, please. They're so hungry.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，求你了。它们太饿了。

lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 掉进了一锅室温的水里。她全身湿透，除此之外没事。

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah. Get tender. Take that, meat. Yeah. So tender. Using a cool hammer. This meat's gonna be so good. Oh yeah. Meat. Let's go. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对。对。变嫩吧。吃这一下，肉。对。真嫩。用一把酷锤子。这肉肯定超好吃。哦耶。肉。走起。对。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut15 with flash
: Hi! Welcome to Sekai's. You're the new chef, right?
lines.zh: : 嗨！欢迎来 Sekai's。你就是新来的厨师吧？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. There’s no need to be so quiet. You’re safe here. You get health benefits and everything.
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。没必要这么安静。你在这儿很安全。你有医保，还有各种福利。

lines.en: : He’s beautiful, isn’t he? The huggy boy. Too bad I am his employer and can not pursue a romantic relationship with him.
lines.zh: : 他很美，对吧？那个抱抱男孩。可惜我是他的雇主，不能跟他发展恋爱关系。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut16
: You know, {i}I{/i} was the first person to ever go to the moon.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，{i}我{/i}是第一个登上月球的人。

lines.en: : I guess that’s not very impressive anymore though, is it? Everybody goes there now.
lines.zh: : 不过我想现在这已经不算什么了，对吧？现在人人都去那儿。

lines.en: : Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut17
: Oh! Sorry. Where are my manners? My name is Sekai. I'm the owner of Sekai's. I named it after myself.
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉。我太失礼了。我叫 Sekai。我是 Sekai's 的老板。店名就是照我自己起的。

lines.en: : Do you like dogs?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢狗吗？

lines.en: : They're...fine.
lines.zh: : 它们……挺好的。

lines.en: : Great! Thanks for letting me know.
lines.zh: : 太好了！谢谢你的情报。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut23 with flash
: {i}What kind of dogs do you like?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你喜欢什么样的狗？{/i}

lines.en: : I...don't know! The last time I visited a shelter was with the Emerald Guardian, but...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道！我上次去收容所是跟翡翠守护者一起，可是……

lines.en: : But the Emerald Guardian...claims that...nothing happened that night! So maybe I did not visit a shelter at all?!
lines.zh: : 可是翡翠守护者……声称……那天晚上什么都没发生！所以也许我根本没去过收容所？！

lines.en: : She's gaslighting you. You were there. I saw you.
lines.zh: : 她在精神操控你。你当时就在那儿。我看见你了。

lines.en: : No! This is...clearly fictional! I wish for this nightmare to end...now!
lines.zh: : 不！这……明显是虚构的！我希望这场噩梦结束……就现在！

lines.en: : I know for a fact that’s not true, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我知道那不是真的，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : How do-
lines.zh: : 你怎么——

lines.en: : I know because {i}I{/i} am a dog.
lines.zh: : 我知道，因为{i}我{/i}就是一条狗。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut24 with flash
: ...What?
: {i}And Makoto is a bat.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而 Makoto 是只蝙蝠。{/i}

lines.en: : She is?!
lines.zh: : 我营养丰富？！

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut25 with flash
: You’re a good girl who wants to do bad things. And I’m a bad girl who wants to do good things. Together, we can rob a bank.
lines.zh: : 你是个想做坏事的乖女孩。我是个想做善事的坏女孩。我们联手，可以抢银行。

lines.en: : What do you say? Ready to get your hands dirty and join a crime syndicate with a dog who owns a restaurant?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？准备好弄脏双手，跟一条开餐厅的狗一起加入犯罪集团了吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut26
: No one will ever expect it!
lines.zh: : 没人会想到的！

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut27
: Especially not the mafia.
lines.zh: : 尤其是黑手党。

lines.en: scene black
: Unless {i}somebody{/i} tells them...
lines.zh: : 除非{i}有人{/i}去告诉他们……

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut30
The snow was cold because it was snow. This line didn't have to be changed and I think that's cool.
lines.zh: 雪很冷，因为它是雪。这句本来不用改，我觉得这挺酷的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut47 with flash
Pretty much everything else did beside this one shot, though. So I guess look at this guy for a while.
lines.zh: 不过除了这一个镜头，其他几乎全都得改。所以你就盯着这家伙看一会儿吧。

lines.en: : Outside, you see a man planting a tree.
lines.zh: : 外面，你看见一个男人在种树。

lines.en: : Yes, he's right over there.
lines.zh: : 对，他就在那边。

lines.en: : You picture him hugging you.
lines.zh: : 你想象他抱着你。

lines.en: : Yay, love.
lines.zh: : 耶，爱。

lines.en: : He hugs you so hard that he fuses into your body and seizes your organs as his own!
lines.zh: : 他抱得太用力，直接融进你身体里，把你的器官据为己有！

lines.en: : Aaaaaah stop that!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊别说了！

lines.en: : You’ve finally met God! He gives you the weekend off! It's time to party with your friends!
lines.zh: : 你终于见到上帝了！他放你周末的假！该跟朋友们去狂欢了！

lines.en: : Let's get crunk, bros. I'm so full of organs.
lines.zh: : 兄弟们，嗨起来。我满肚子都是器官。

lines.en: : From that point on, it’s chaos! You're all playing beer pong, but nobody knows how!
lines.zh: : 从那一刻起，一片混乱！你们都在玩啤酒乒乓，可没人会玩！

lines.en: : False friends! True pong! Peerless and pearless punch, the kind that's red and tastes vaguely like HI-C! Yummy yummy in your tummy!
lines.zh: : 假朋友！真乒乓！无双、也无梨的潘趣酒，那种红色的、喝起来隐约像 HI-C 的！在你肚子里香香甜甜！

lines.en: : I can’t...hold on...much longer!
: Then get off the jungle gym.
lines.zh: : 那就从攀爬架上下来。

lines.en: : Ngh! Sorry. I was trying to set a record.
lines.zh: : 唔！抱歉。我想破个纪录。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut13
But then you realize you were never at a party at all. You've been at Sekai's the entire time.
lines.zh: 但接着你意识到，你根本没在什么派对上。你一直都在 Sekai's。

lines.en: The soup of the day is lobster bisque and the nightly special is a New York strip. There are no rabbits anywhere to be found. Just meat.
lines.zh: 今日例汤是龙虾浓汤，今晚特餐是纽约客牛排。到处都找不到兔子。只有肉。

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah. Get tender. Take that, meat. Yeah. So tender. Using a cool hammer. This meat's gonna be so good. Oh yeah. Meat. Let's go. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对。对。变嫩吧。吃这一下，肉。对。真嫩。用一把酷锤子。这肉肯定超好吃。哦耶。肉。走起。对。

lines.en: : Mnh...mmm...
: This lobster bisque is so good.
lines.zh: : 这龙虾浓汤真好喝。

lines.en: : It should have been meat.
lines.zh: : 本来该是肉的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyocut50 with flash
: Ngh?!?
scene tsuneyocut51
scene tsuneyocut52 with flash
$ renpy.pause(5, hard=True)
scene black
$ renpy.pause(2, hard=True)
: Oh no...
: I can't feed rabbits my blood.
lines.zh: : 我不能拿我的血喂兔子。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel1
: Here — a gift from me to you.
lines.zh: : 给——我送你的礼物。

lines.en: : Is that a gift card to Dave & Buster's?
lines.zh: : 那是 Dave & Buster's 的礼品卡？

lines.en: : I know how much Rin loves ski-ball.
lines.zh: : 我知道 Rin 有多喜欢玩 ski-ball。

lines.en: : We can use this on the games?? It's not just for food??
lines.zh: : 这能用来玩游戏？？不只是能买吃的？？

lines.en: : You can use it for whatever you like. I am so very kind.
lines.zh: : 你想用它干什么都行。我真是太善良了。

lines.en: : You...got a Dave & Buster's gift card for just...the two of us?
lines.zh: : 你……就为了……我们俩，弄了张 Dave & Buster's 的礼品卡？

lines.en: : I know it is best enjoyed in larger groups. But I believe you two have earned a night off.
lines.zh: : 我知道人多一起去才最好玩。但我相信你们俩该放一晚上假了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel3
: Also, I am going to hug the huggy boy and I don't want you two around to hear it.
lines.zh: : 还有，我要去抱抱男孩了，我不想你们俩在旁边听见。

lines.en: : Are...you sure you don’t want to come with us and Sensei can just hang out all by himself in a dark room?
lines.zh: : 你……确定不想跟我们一起去，让 Sensei 自己一个人待在一间黑屋子里？

lines.en: : Getting cold feet, Rin? This could be your chance to finally win enough tickets for that giant Minion you've been wanting.
lines.zh: : 打退堂鼓了，Rin？这可是你终于赢够票、换到那个你一直想要的大 Minion 的机会。

lines.en: : Or fall into one of the holes after Otoha zaps me with her shrink ray.
lines.zh: : 或者被 Otoha 用她的缩小射线打中之后掉进哪个洞里。

lines.en: : Damn it. Who told you about the shrink ray?
lines.zh: : 妈的。谁跟你说了缩小射线的事？

lines.en: : I’ll come with you next time. For now, enjoy the night out. But don't stay up {i}too{/i} late because I care about your health and don't want it to impact your sleep schedule.
lines.zh: : 下次我跟你们一起去。这次你们好好享受这个晚上。但别熬得{i}太{/i}晚，因为我在乎你们的健康，不想它影响你们的睡眠作息。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel4
: What? No deal. I don't even like Dave & Buster's.
lines.zh: : 什么？不行。我根本不喜欢 Dave & Buster's。

lines.en: : Otoha, you've never even been to one.
lines.zh: : Otoha，你根本就没去过。

lines.en: : There are just so many dudes there. Aren't they going to try and hug us?
lines.zh: : 那儿的男人太多了。他们不会想抱我们吧？

lines.en: : Yeaaaaaah, but who {i}cares{/i} so long as we can convince them to give us their tickets.
lines.zh: : 是——啊，但只要能说服他们把票给我们，谁{i}在乎{/i}啊。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel5
: I do...also want the giant Minion.
lines.zh: : 我……也想要那个大 Minion。

lines.en: : You’re 100%% sure?
: Yeah...it’s fine.
: You’re {i}1000%%{/i} sure?
: Rin, just take the card.
lines.zh: : Rin，把卡拿着。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel6
: {i}Thank you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你。{/i}

lines.en: : Feel free to take my scooter there as well. It goes really fast.
lines.zh: : 也可以骑我的小摩托去。它跑得特别快。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel7
Rin and Otoha scurry off to Dave & Buster's. I'm pretty sad I wasn't invited.
lines.zh: Rin 和 Otoha 匆匆跑去了 Dave & Buster's。没被邀请，我挺难过的。

lines.en: : They grow up so quickly, don’t they? I can't believe they're college age women who are old enough to legally consent now.
lines.zh: : 她们长得多快啊，对吧？真不敢相信她们已经是到了法定同意年龄的大学生了。

lines.en: : What are {i}we{/i} gonna do though? I'm already at my hug limit for the day.
lines.zh: : 那{i}我们{/i}要做什么？我今天已经到拥抱上限了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel8
: The huggy boy has a huggy limit?
lines.zh: : 抱抱男孩还有拥抱上限？

lines.en: : It's more of a guideline.
lines.zh: : 那更像是参考值。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel9
: Well, {i}someone{/i} has to teach you how to push past it. And I could really use one million hugs.
lines.zh: : 总得{i}有人{/i}教你怎么突破它。而且我真的很需要一百万个拥抱。

lines.en: : Our chamber awaits, Doug-kun. I hope there's a big red dog there.
lines.zh: : 我们的密室在等着我们，Doug-kun。我希望那儿有条大红色的狗。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka turns around and walks down the same path Rin and Otoha followed just moments ago. We see Haruka along the way. It looks like she's lost again.
lines.zh: Nodoka 转过身，沿着 Rin 和 Otoha 刚才走的那条路走去。路上我们看见了 Haruka。她好像又迷路了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel10
: I have a hard time seeing things when I take my glasses off.
lines.zh: : 我把眼镜摘了就看不清东西。

lines.en: : Then keep them on.
lines.zh: : 那就戴着。

lines.en: : Tell me. Is there a big red dog here?
lines.zh: : 告诉我。这儿有条大红色的狗吗？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel11
: Not yet...no.
: I wonder how the trip to Dave & Buster's is going. It might take an hour or two before things really {i}kick off.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不知道他们去 Dave & Buster's 怎么样了。可能得过一两个小时事情才会真正{i}开场{/i}。

lines.en: : Why...do you want a hug so badly in the first place? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么……那么想要拥抱？我不明白。

lines.en: : Why do the sands sing? Or the mountains moan?
lines.zh: : 沙子为什么会唱歌？山峦为什么会低吟？

lines.en: : Why does the huggy {i}boy?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那抱抱{i}男孩{/i}又为什么？

lines.en: : No one knows.
lines.zh: : 没人知道。

lines.en: : It has something to do with vibrations. That much is certain. That's how sound {i}works,{/i} I think.
lines.zh: : 这跟振动有关。这一点是确定的。声音就是{i}这么{/i}运作的，我想。

lines.en: : But the melodies created by air alone could not possibly sound that...beautifully ominous, could they?
lines.zh: : 可单靠空气奏出的旋律，不可能听起来那么......美妙的不祥，对吧？

lines.en: : There is something else at play. Something we don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 还有别的东西在起作用。某种我们无法理解的东西。

lines.en: : Why are you making hugs so complicated?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要把拥抱搞得这么复杂？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel12
: Let me be the thing you can’t explain.
lines.zh: : 让我成为你无法解释的那个东西吧。

lines.en: : I think that's already what you are. But at least you haven't asked me to make any bone necklaces with you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你本来就是那样了。不过至少你还没让我跟你一起做骨头项链。

lines.en: : {i}Hello? Is this where the bone necklace club is meeting tonight?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有人吗？骨头项链俱乐部今晚是在这儿聚会吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh no. She's here.
lines.zh: : 糟了。她来了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel13
: You asked me earlier why I started writing. My response was to confuse you.
lines.zh: : 你先前问过我为什么开始写作。我的回答是为了把你弄糊涂。

lines.en: : I apologize for screaming so loudly in public and dumping my latte in your lap. It was just the first thing that came to mind.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我在公共场合叫得那么大声，还把拿铁倒在你腿上。那只是我脑子里冒出来的第一个念头。

lines.en: : That's fine. I don't ever intend to have {size=-15}intercourse{/size} with anyone, so it's fine if I get skin grafts and stuff down there.
lines.zh: : 没事。我压根没打算跟任何人{size=-15}做爱{/size}，所以那儿就算要植皮什么的也无所谓。

lines.en: : There’s someone I know who loves books.
lines.zh: : 我认识一个人，她爱书。

lines.en: : Futaba, right? Her parents died. Did you know?
lines.zh: : Futaba，对吧？她父母死了。你知道吗？

lines.en: : For years and years, they were all she had.
lines.zh: : 年复一年，那些书就是她的全部。

lines.en: : Yeah. That's why it's depressing.
lines.zh: : 知道。所以才让人难受。

lines.en: : Fiction was her favorite. And from a creaky chair in the middle of a mostly-empty living room, she’d throw herself into story after story because her world was far too drab.
lines.zh: : 她最喜欢虚构作品。在一间几乎空荡荡的客厅中央，她坐在那把嘎吱作响的椅子上，一头扎进一个又一个故事里，因为她的世界实在太单调乏味了。

lines.en: : And then her parents died. The end.
lines.zh: : 然后她父母死了。完。

lines.en: : You're really not a very good writer.
lines.zh: : 你真不是个多好的作家。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel14 with flash
: You asked me earlier why I started writing. My response was to confuse you.
lines.zh: : 你先前问过我为什么开始写作。我的回答是为了把你弄糊涂。

lines.en: : Now, all I’m doing is confusing myself.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我只是在把自己弄糊涂。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} still Akira, right? I can't see.
lines.zh: : 你{i}还是{/i} Akira，对吧？我看不见。

lines.en: : Just put your glasses back on, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 把眼镜戴回去，Nodoka。

lines.en: : You don’t think that’s {i}all{/i} I do, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会以为我{i}只{/i}会这一招吧？

lines.en: : Put glasses on? Clearly not.
lines.zh: : 把眼镜戴上？才不要。

lines.en: : I’m no one trick pony, Akira. I can put all sorts of stuff on. Top hats. Fedoras. Beanies.
lines.zh: : 我可不是只会一招的小马，Akira。我能戴各种东西。高礼帽。软呢帽。毛线帽。

lines.en: : Those are all just different types of hats.
lines.zh: : 那些全都只是不同类型的帽子。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault that the ones people seem to be the most interested in are the ones that cost the most.
lines.zh: : 人们最感兴趣的那些恰好是最贵的那些，这又不是我的错。

lines.en: : That’s just human nature, I suppose — obsessively curious and demonstrably sick.
lines.zh: : 我想这就是人性吧——病态地好奇，而且明显有病。

lines.en: : Can we go to Dave & Buster's now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在能去 Dave & Buster's 了吗？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel15
: Is that what you want?
lines.zh: : 这是你想的吗?

lines.en: : If I had to choose...yeah. That’s probably what I’d go with.
lines.zh: : 要是非得选……嗯。我大概就会选那个。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那没问题。

lines.en: : But I’m hesitant to agree since I think Rin and Otoha deserve some time alone and I really want to hug you.
lines.zh: : 但我不太想同意，因为我觉得 Rin 和 Otoha 该有些独处的时间，而且我真的很想抱你。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel17
scene nodokahotel18
: That doesn’t mean I don’t crave other stuff too.
lines.zh: : 这不代表我就不渴望别的东西。

lines.en: : You better not be flirting with me right now, crazy lady.
lines.zh: : 你最好不是在跟我调情，疯女人。

lines.en: : Akira, I brought a clown costume.
lines.zh: : Akira，我带了小丑装。

lines.en: : {i}No.
scene nodokahotel19
: I heard from Chika how much you like them.
lines.zh: : 我从 Chika 那儿听说你有多喜欢它们。

lines.en: : I also know where you're keeping the secret path to Hogwarts.
lines.zh: : 我还知道你把通往 Hogwarts 的秘密通道藏在哪儿。

lines.en: : Even in the huggy dimension, you still know everything. Don't you?
lines.zh: : 就算在抱抱维度，你也还是什么都知道。对吧？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel20
: MEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE? NUH-UHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Yup, there it is. You always get super dramatic when lying about yourself. That's a character trait I just willed into existence.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这样。你每次撒谎说自己都会特别夸张。这个性格特点是我刚刚凭空造出来的。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel21
: Hmm...
: Did you know I'm wearing a swimsuit underneath this regular suit?
lines.zh: : 你知道我在这套普通西装下面穿着泳衣吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene nodokahotel22
: Yeah, look. There's supposed to be a pool in the hotel. Let's go swimming. This is a swimsuit. It's not NSFW.
lines.zh: : 对，你看。这酒店里应该有个泳池。我们去游泳吧。这是泳衣。不是什么少儿不宜的东西。

lines.en: : I don't know, Nodoka...I...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Nodoka……我……

lines.en: : I never learned to swim.
lines.zh: : 我从没学过游泳。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel23
: Never?
lines.zh: : 绝不？

lines.en: : Never.
lines.zh: : 绝无此事。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel24
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel25
: I could teach you if you want. I'm pretty good. And I promise I won't let you float away no matter how funny I think it would be.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我可以教你。我挺擅长的。而且我保证不会让你飘走，不管我觉得那有多好笑。

lines.en: : Thanks, Nodoka. I-
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Nodoka。我——

lines.en: : Only those who have {i}seen{/i} a cat can draw one.
lines.zh: : 只有{i}见过{/i}猫的人，才画得出猫。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Just a quick cat fact. What were we talking about again?
lines.zh: : 说个关于猫的冷知识。我们刚才在聊什么来着？

lines.en: : Swimming.
lines.zh: : 游泳。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel26
: Oh.
: Yeah, I don't know how to do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道该怎么做那个。

lines.en: : I just really like swimsuits.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的很喜欢泳衣。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel27
: I bet you think I'm a real dork now, huh?
lines.zh: : 我打赌你现在觉得我是个十足的呆子，对吧？

lines.en: : Not at all, Nodoka. I'm glad that you have hobbies and interests and wish you nothing but success in life.
lines.zh: : 完全没有，Nodoka。我很高兴你有爱好和兴趣，也祝你在人生中一切顺利。

lines.en: : I hope I get shot in the head.
lines.zh: : 我希望我被人一枪打中脑袋。

lines.en: : Wow, what the heck
lines.zh: : 哇，搞什么鬼

lines.en: scene nodokahotel28
: I’m not trying to make you feel bad.
lines.zh: : 我不是想让您难受。

lines.en: : Did you think that would make me feel {i}good?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你觉得那样会让我觉得{i}舒服{/i}吗？

lines.en: : The point I’m getting at is that it is {i}okay{/i} to be a horrible person with horrible vices and that things like that should be {i}embraced.{/i} Like a hug.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，做个有糟糕恶习的糟糕人是{i}没问题{/i}的，这种事应该被{i}拥抱{/i}。就像拥抱一样。

lines.en: : That’s a horrible, disgusting lesson and an even more disgusting mindset. Don't ever compare hugs to vices again or I'll step on your foot.
lines.zh: : 这是个糟糕又恶心的道理，心态更恶心。别再拿拥抱跟恶习比了，不然我踩你脚。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel29
: Joke's on you. I don't {i}have{/i} feet.
lines.zh: : 笑死，我{i}根本没{/i}有脚。

lines.en: I look down and- oh my god, she doesn't.
lines.zh: 我低头一看——我的天，她真没有。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel30
: Amy took them.
lines.zh: : Amy 拿走了。

lines.en: : Who?
: She shows up later. Ask for my feet back please.
lines.zh: : 她后面会出场。请帮我要回我的脚。

lines.en: : I'll try to remember that.
lines.zh: : 我会尽量记住的。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel31
: Hey. Do you think this girl will come work at Sekai's? Tsuneyo just quit.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你觉得这姑娘会来 Sekai's 上班吗？Tsuneyo 刚辞职了。

lines.en: scene nodokahotel32
: Wow, what a nice swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 哇，这泳衣真不错。

lines.en: : What do you say, Dougkira?
lines.zh: : 怎么说，Dougkira？

lines.en: : Do you want to see the clown costume? Or do you want to drink champagne and binge watch Love is Blind with me?
lines.zh: : 你想看小丑装？还是想跟我一起喝香槟、刷《Love is Blind》？

lines.en: : I still want to go to Dave & Buster's.
lines.zh: : 我还是想去 Dave & Buster's。

lines.en: : Fine. I'll put my regular suit back on.
lines.zh: : 行吧。我把我那套普通西装穿回去。

: Akira, Akira, Akira...
lines.zh: : Akira，Akira，Akira......

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think you have a problem.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你有问题了。

lines.en: : Knock, knock.
lines.zh: : 咚咚。

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick10
: Oh, {i}I’m{/i} sorry. Do you think you’re in the position to be making jokes right now?
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗。你觉得你现在有资格开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Are we...not friends anymore?
lines.zh: : 我们……不再是朋友了？

lines.en: : Of course we're friends. If we stop being friends, I'll need to find someone else to join my bowling league. Do you know how hard that is on such short notice?
lines.zh: : 我们当然是朋友。要是我们不做朋友了，我就得另找人加入我的保龄球联赛。你知道临时找有多难吗？

lines.en: : Uh...hard?
lines.zh: : 呃……硬的？

lines.en: : Not really. But I still don't want to do it.
lines.zh: : 不太清楚。但我还是不想做。

lines.en: : I’ll, uhh...
: I guess I’ll be going now.
lines.zh: : 我想我现在该走了。

lines.en: : No you won’t.
lines.zh: : 不，你不会走。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Do you know what day it is, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你知道今天是什么日子吗，Akira？

lines.en: : Uhh...C...Christmas?
: That is correct. And do you remember what I told you I was doing on Christmas?
lines.zh: : 正确。那么，你还记得我告诉过你圣诞节这天我要做什么吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but...I really don't get why you {i}have{/i} to watch Die Hard today. Can't you do it tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可是……我真不明白你为什么{i}非得{/i}今天看 Die Hard。不能明天看吗？

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick11
: Does one watch {i}Elf{/i} or {i}A Christmas Story{/i} the day {i}after{/i} Christmas, Akira? No. Because that's {i}stupid. Are you telling me you're stupid?
lines.zh: : 有人会在圣诞节{i}之后{/i}那天才看{i}Elf{/i}或者{i}A Christmas Story{/i}吗，Akira？不会。因为那很{i}蠢。你是想说你很蠢吗？

lines.en: : Maaaaaybe?
lines.zh: : 也……也许吧？

lines.en: : We are going to watch Die Hard and you are going to like it. Otherwise, I am going to tell the whole world that the huggy boy is giving hugs in the {i}bathroom now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们要看 Die Hard，而且你会喜欢的。不然我就告诉全世界，抱抱男孩现在开始在{i}浴室{/i}里给人拥抱了。

lines.en: : Do you think I am happy about that, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我对此很高兴吗，Akira？

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick12
: Probably...not...
: {i}Very{/i} good! But I’m a little confused. Didn’t I give you a {i}job{/i} to do today?
lines.zh: : {i}非常{/i}好！不过我有点困惑。我今天不是交代了你一件{i}差事{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I was supposed to shave Tsukasa's head...
lines.zh: : 我本来该给 Tsukasa 剃头的……

lines.en: : But {i}of course{/i} you weren't able to strap her to the chair because of your weak little noodle arms, yes?
lines.zh: : 但{i}当然{/i}你没把她绑在椅子上，因为你那两条软面条似的小胳膊，对吧？

lines.en: : Hugs don't feel as good when you're covered in muscles...
lines.zh: : 浑身都是肌肉的时候，拥抱感觉没那么好……

lines.en: : So what? My daughter just {i}still{/i} has hair then?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？那我女儿头上{i}还是{/i}有头发咯？

lines.en: : Why do you want to get rid of it in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你一开始为什么想把它去掉？

lines.en: : Because Bruce Willis is bald now, Akira! I wanted a son! I wanted a son I could name Bruce Willis and treat like Bruce Willis! And I like Touka more, so Tsukasa's hair is as good as gone!
lines.zh: : 因为 Bruce Willis 现在秃了，Akira！我想要个儿子！我想要个能取名叫 Bruce Willis、当 Bruce Willis 一样对待的儿子！而且我更喜欢 Touka，所以 Tsukasa 的头发基本没救了！

lines.en: : But thanks to you, she's probably wandering around, having hair and getting into trouble and putting {i}everything{/i} at risk. I HATE YOU, HUGGY BOY.
lines.zh: : 但多亏了你，她现在大概正到处晃悠，留着头发、惹着麻烦，把{i}一切{/i}都置于危险之中。我恨你，抱抱男孩。

lines.en: : I love your pajama pants, though. They look very comfy.
lines.zh: : 不过我挺喜欢你这条睡裤的。看起来很舒服。

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick11 with flash
: Thanks. I got them from the GAP. And I am glad that we have established I am fully clothed right now. As I have always been from the moment I was born.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我在 GAP 买的。而且我很高兴我们已经确认了，我现在是穿着衣服的。从我一出生起就一直如此。

lines.en: : That sounds rough. Can we go watch Die Hard now please?
lines.zh: : 听起来真惨。我们现在能去看 Die Hard 了吗？

lines.en: : Only if I get to choose what we watch next.
lines.zh: : 除非下一个看什么由我来选。

lines.en: : No. You're just going to pick the third season of Seinfeld again like you always do. Is there a Christmas episode in season three, Akira?
lines.zh: : 不行。你又会像每次都那样挑《Seinfeld》第三季。第三季里有圣诞特辑吗，Akira？

lines.en: : Yes. The Red Dot. Season three, episode twelve. When Elaine gets George a job at her publishing company, George reciprocates by buying her a cashmere sweater for Christmas.
lines.zh: : 有。《The Red Dot》。第三季第十二集。Elaine 帮 George 在她的出版社找了份工作，George 作为回报，圣诞节送了她一件羊绒毛衣。

lines.en: : The thing is, he got it at a discount because it had a red dot on it. So Elaine got mad and-
lines.zh: : 问题是，他是打折买的，因为上面有个红点。所以 Elaine 生气了，然后——

lines.en: : Okay, fine. We can watch the third season of Seinfeld. But Die Hard is first. And time is of the essence. The manor is going to explode at the end of the night.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。我们可以看《Seinfeld》第三季。但先看 Die Hard。时间很紧。庄园今晚结束的时候会爆炸。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Because I am evil. That's why. Also, who are your little floating friends?
lines.zh: : 因为我很邪恶。就这么简单。对了，你那几个飘着的小朋友是谁？

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick15 with flash
: Ahhh! She can see us!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！她看得见我们！

lines.en: : Everyone, beat it!
lines.zh: : 大家，撤！

lines.en: : These are the monks. They're nice, I promise.
lines.zh: : 这几位是僧侣。他们人很好，我保证。

lines.en: : How do {i}they{/i} feel about Bruce Willis?
lines.zh: : {i}他们{/i}对 Bruce Willis 怎么看？

lines.en: : They won’t leave me alone, Tsubasa. I just want to enjoy Christmas. And they want me to think they’re my friends, but they’re not. They hate me. You hate me. Everyone hates me.
lines.zh: : 他们不肯放过我，Tsubasa。我只想好好过个圣诞节。可他们想让我以为他们是朋友，但他们不是。他们恨我。你恨我。所有人都恨我。

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick9 with flash
: Well, yeah. Probably because you're so annoying and insist on protecting everybody all the time when {i}I{/i} think we should blow them up.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。大概是因为你太烦人，老是坚持保护所有人，而{i}我{/i}觉得我们应该把他们炸了。

lines.en: : I knew it. We {i}aren't{/i} friends. You hate me too.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。我们{i}不是{/i}朋友。你也恨我。

lines.en: : Of course we’re friends. If we weren’t, I’d have blown you up by now.
lines.zh: : 我们当然是朋友。要不是的话，我早就把你炸了。

lines.en: : You probably should, to be honest. I have gone too far with my first bathroom hug.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你可能真该炸了我。我那次在浴室的第一次拥抱，做得太过分了。

lines.en: : Nonsense. How would I ever explain that to Touka? She’s quite excited to hug you one day. And I’m excited to film it and sell it to the cartel.
lines.zh: : 胡说。我要怎么跟 Touka 解释？她可期待有一天能抱你了。而我很期待把它拍下来，卖给贩毒集团。

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick10
: But alas — you see her as your {i}mother.{/i} And surely you wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 可悲的是——你把她当成自己的{i}母亲{/i}。而你肯定不会-

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick19
: Ah.
: Don't...look at it, please.
lines.zh: : 别……看那个，求你了。

lines.en: : Is that...a mood ring?
lines.zh: : 那是……一枚情绪戒指？

lines.en: : I told you not to look at it. It's embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 我说了别看的。很丢人。

lines.en: : HAH! The huggy boy is wearing a mood ring in 2020?! What color is it now? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 哈！抱抱男孩在 2020 年还戴情绪戒指？！现在是什么颜色？那代表什么？

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick20
: It's blue and that means I'm sad because you're bullying me.
lines.zh: : 是蓝色的，意思是我很难过，因为你在欺负我。

lines.en: : Take your hand, wrap it around that pole to your left I bought from some girl named Jessica, and keep doing that until your hands get all sweaty.
lines.zh: : 把手伸出来，抱住你左边那根我从一个叫 Jessica 的女孩那儿买来的杆子，一直抱到你手全是汗为止。

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick30 with flash
: Because I'm evil and I said so!
lines.zh: : 因为我很邪恶，我说了算！

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick31
: Hah...hah...haah...
: {i}Mother, are we still going to Die Hard tonight? I shaved Tsukasa's head myself. She kept asking me about dancing. It was very strange.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}妈妈，我们今晚还去看 Die Hard 吗？Tsukasa 的头是我自己剃的。她一直问我跳舞的事。很奇怪。{/i}

lines.en: : In a moment, dear! I'm teaching the huggy boy a lesson right now.
lines.zh: : 马上就好，亲爱的！我正在给抱抱男孩上一课。

lines.en: : {i}He's here?! In the bathroom?! You two aren't hugging, are you?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他在这儿？！在浴室里？！你们俩不是在拥抱吧？！{/i}

lines.en: : Touka, help! Your mom is bullying me! And this pole she's making me rub is super sticky! I need your help to break free!
lines.zh: : Touka，救命！你妈在欺负我！还有她逼我抱的这根杆子超级黏！我需要你帮我脱身！

lines.en: : You...want me to touch it?!
lines.zh: : 您......要我去碰它？！

lines.en: : She’s right outside, Akira. But the door is locked. She will {i}never{/i} help you.
lines.zh: : 她就在门外，Akira。但门锁着。她{i}永远不会{/i}帮你。

lines.en: : Not like this...not...like this...
: {i}S...Sensei! The door is locked! I can not help you! I must away! Whoooosh!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}S……Sensei！门锁着！我帮不了你！我得走了！嗖——！{/i}

lines.en: : She's a superhero now. I gave her powers because I am evil.
lines.zh: : 她现在是个超级英雄了。我给了她能力，因为我很邪恶。

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick32
: Can I have powers too?
lines.zh: : 我也能有能力吗？

lines.en: : Depends. What are you willing to do for me once you finish rubbing the pole I bought from Jessica?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你抱完那根我从 Jessica 那儿买来的杆子之后，愿意为我做什么？

lines.en: : And also after we watch Die Hard, which I'm still going to make you do.
lines.zh: : 还有在我们看完 Die Hard 之后，我还是会逼你看的。

lines.en: : Whatever you want! Just name it!
lines.zh: : 什么都行！你尽管说！

lines.en: : Make my daughter the huggy girl!
lines.zh: : 让我女儿成为抱抱女孩！

lines.en: : There can {i}be{/i} no huggy girl! The prophecy does not allow it!
lines.zh: : 根本{i}不可能{/i}有抱抱女孩！预言不允许！

lines.en: scene tsubasadoesntwantxmasdick33
: Then I will kill you in here. Just like I killed Futaba's parents.
lines.zh: : 那我就在这儿杀了你。就像我杀了 Futaba 的父母一样。

lines.en: : Noooooo! She really liked them! Why is all the huggy lore connecting now?!
lines.zh: : 不要啊啊啊！她真的很喜欢他们！为什么所有抱抱设定现在都串起来了？！

lines.en: : Because I'm {i}evil!{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我很{i}邪恶！{/i}

lines.en: scene osakonewhair20 with flash
: So, what are we watching?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们在看什么？

lines.en: : The third season of Seinfeld. I borrowed it from my friend Kirin.
lines.zh: : 《Seinfeld》第三季。我跟朋友 Kirin 借的。

lines.en: : I fucking hate you, Akira. George reminds me of my dad.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨你，Akira。George 让我想起我爸。

lines.en: : This is great, guys. Now we can start a Seinfeld club.
lines.zh: : 太好了，各位。现在我们可以办个《Seinfeld》俱乐部了。

lines.en: : I already have one! It’s called “Seinfeld Club!”
lines.zh: : 我已经有一个了！就叫「Seinfeld Club」！

lines.en: : You know, as a tried and true lesbian woman, I’ve gotta say...it feels kind of weird watching Seinfeld — a show without any lesbians.
lines.zh: : 你知道，作为一个货真价实的女同性恋，我得说……看《Seinfeld》感觉有点怪——一部一个女同性恋都没有的剧。

lines.en: : That's not true. George's ex Susan is a lesbian.
lines.zh: : 不对。George 的前女友 Susan 是女同性恋。

lines.en: : Yeah. And there's also that episode where Elaine misses a lesbian wedding because of train delays.
lines.zh: : 对。还有那一集，Elaine 因为火车晚点错过了一场女同性恋的婚礼。

lines.en: : The Subway. Season three, episode thirteen. Right after the Red Dot.
lines.zh: : 《The Subway》。第三季第十三集。就在《The Red Dot》之后。

lines.en: : Can we put that one on? As a tried and true lesbian woman, I’ve gotta say...I'm interested in lesbian weddings.
lines.zh: : 能放那一集吗？作为一个货真价实的女同性恋，我得说……我对女同性恋的婚礼很感兴趣。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair23
I navigate the Seinfeld Season 3 DVD menu with ease since I've done it so many times before and put on The Subway. Great episode. Right after the Red Dot.
lines.zh: 我轻车熟路地操作《Seinfeld》第三季 DVD 菜单，因为我以前干过太多次了，然后放上了《The Subway》。很棒的一集。就在《The Red Dot》之后。

lines.en: : Thanks, huggy boy.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，抱抱男孩。

lines.en: : You know, you're not so bad.
lines.zh: : 你知道，你其实没那么糟。

lines.en: : That's a real relief to hear. It was just the other day that the richest woman in Kumon-mi was threatening to blow me up because I hugged someone in a bathroom.
lines.zh: : 听到这话真让人松口气。就在前几天，Kumon-mi 最有钱的女人还威胁要炸了我，就因为我在浴室里抱了别人。

lines.en: : In a perfect world, we'd be able to hug whoever we want...wherever we want...whenever we want.
lines.zh: : 在一个完美的世界里，我们就能想抱谁就抱谁……想在哪抱就在哪抱……想什么时候抱就什么时候抱。

lines.en: : I agree. I've just really been doubting myself lately.
lines.zh: : 我同意。我只是最近真的很怀疑自己。

lines.en: : I mean, I haven't even shown my face in years. Once Patreon was pulled, I figured that was it for me. What reason do I have to exist? What purpose do I-
lines.zh: : 我是说，我连脸都几年没露过了。Patreon 一被撤掉，我就觉得我完了。我有什么理由存在？我的目的是什么——

lines.en: : Can you guys shut up? I'm trying to watch Seinfeld.
lines.zh: : 你们能闭嘴吗？我在看《Seinfeld》。

lines.en: : {i}(Distant bat noises){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}（远处传来蝙蝠的声音）{/i}

lines.en: scene osakonewhair24
: Woah, what was that?
lines.zh: : 哇，那是什么声音？

lines.en: : Just one more creature who wants to be the huggy girl...but is something else entirely.
lines.zh: : 又一个想当抱抱女孩的家伙……但它完全是别的东西。

lines.en: : It's my daughter. She- oh, look! There's a can of soup over there in the fern.
lines.zh: : 是我女儿。她——哦，看！那边蕨类植物里有一罐汤。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair29
: So anyway, what's all this about doubting yourself? You're not actually struggling...are you, huggy boy?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你怀疑自己是怎么回事？你不是真的在挣扎吧……抱抱男孩？

lines.en: : I...think I am, Osako. Nobody gets this version of me. It's like I'm a joke to everyone or something. I just want to hug.
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得是的，Osako。没人懂我这个样子。就好像我对所有人来说都是个笑话之类的。我只是想拥抱。

lines.en: : I don't think you're a joke, huggy boy. Not one bit.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你是个笑话，抱抱男孩。一点也不。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair23
: You know...back when I was young, people had really high expectations of me.
lines.zh: : 你知道……我年轻的时候，人们对我期望很高。

lines.en: : My parents used to drag me around to all of these weird, like...I don't know. Ritualistic shrines or something?
lines.zh: : 我父母以前老拖着我到处跑，去那些奇怪的，怎么说……我不知道。搞仪式的神社之类的？

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: It was a long time ago and I can't really remember all the details. But, like...
lines.zh: : 那是很久以前的事了，细节我记不太清了。但是，那个……

lines.en: : I remember hearing all of this stuff about some sort of...prophecy. And how {i}I{/i} was the chosen one or something crazy like that.
lines.zh: : 我记得听过一堆关于某种……预言的玩意儿。还有{i}我{/i}就是天选之人之类的疯话。

lines.en: : There was all this money set aside for me and, like...my future was totally planned out. But it became too much and I ran away from home.
lines.zh: : 有一大笔钱为我留着，而且……我的未来完全被安排好了。但那变得太沉重，我就离家出走了。

lines.en: : I still get calls every once in a while...distant relatives screaming at me about how I need to carry on the legacy and how “the world can’t hug itself.” Stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 我偶尔还是会接到电话……远房亲戚冲我吼，说我要继承这份传承，还说「这个世界没法自己抱自己」之类的。就这种事。

lines.en: : Oh my god...
scene osakonewhair29
: Hm? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯?什么?

lines.en: : What else...do you remember?
lines.zh: : 你还……记得什么？

lines.en: : I remember...a light. Brighter than the sun.
lines.zh: : 我记得……一道光。比太阳还亮。

lines.en: : Arms that felt like angels' wings and...I don't know, man. It's weird, crazy religious stuff. It has nothing to do with you.
lines.zh: : 像天使翅膀一样的手臂，还有……我不知道，哥们。就是些奇怪又疯狂的宗教玩意儿。跟你没关系。

lines.en: : Osako...it has {i}everything{/i} to do with me.
lines.zh: : Osako……这跟我{i}全都{/i}有关系。

lines.en: : How so? I don't get it.
lines.zh: : 怎么说？我不明白。

lines.en: : It's you...
lines.zh: : 是你……

lines.en: : It's always been you.
lines.zh: : 一直都是你。

lines.en: : What's always been me?
lines.zh: : 什么一直都是我？

lines.en: : You...
scene black
: You are the true huggy girl...
lines.zh: : 你才是真正的抱抱女孩……
